{"id": "b0ba0c32-3e9d-4226-b274-9f752bdcaed6", "value": "A large natural or artificial body of water, sometimes covered, used to collect and store water for a particular function, eg. industrial or public use."}
{"id": "4b713fca-5660-4afa-a37d-3e0c41f58f43", "value": "Houses specifically of monks, canons or religious men but not friars."}
{"id": "6b6a2f9d-333d-4104-9761-ce5187a53692", "value": "A priory dependent on a foreign mother house. Use with narrow terms of DOUBLE HOUSE, MONASTERY or NUNNERY."}

{"id": "32dd62e7-2a22-46a2-8e0f-92fab1ba056b", "value": "A gateway with one or more chambers over the entrance arch; the flanking towers housing stairs and additional rooms. Use with wider site type where known."}
{"id": "a581c3c6-8416-4479-8498-7e9ef9ead42b", "value": "A building or room where food is prepared and cooked."}
{"id": "9b2ab43f-06b0-4be2-9146-2cb07eb9954e", "value": "A religious house governed by an abbot or abbess. Use with narrow terms of DOUBLE HOUSE, MONASTERY or NUNNERY."}

{"id": "06d27e29-db97-4adf-94e1-cecf570977eb", "value": "A building or room within a monastery in which the monks were allowed to warm themselves. The warming house was often the only place where a fire was allowed."}
{"id": "c5433946-a5f5-4534-b090-c9ffda681d02", "value": "Mixed house of nuns and religious men."}
{"id": "a97e6377-1a37-46f0-9b80-94c6566afd7a", "value": "A tower containing a curfew bell. The bell was rung in the evening, as a signal that fires were to be extinguished."}
{"id": "b102408e-c333-4c0c-b95c-e6ca8fc5e87c", "value": "A communal dining room, especially in schools, colleges and monasteries."}
{"id": "4161e109-09d4-4943-b0cb-3c80f4682767", "value": "A monastery governed by a prior or prioress. Use with narrow terms of DOUBLE HOUSE, FRIARY, MONASTERY or NUNNERY."}
{"id": "089a1f7e-0108-4d85-a842-08f2a2358ca8", "value": "Houses specifically of nuns/canonesses or religious women."}

{"id": "7ae0228a-2097-4b35-ab98-705c26defe05", "value": "Houses specifically for men and of chiefly mendicant religious orders. The status of priory is represented in several friaries. Use with PRIORY if required."}
{"id": "c106de54-18e0-49af-9b94-1533d66cf325", "value": "A wall enclosing a precinct."}

skos:Concept.skos:altLabel: {"id": "4b245b9a-167c-4488-a857-3514fc9da18e", "value": "Preceptory Of The Knights Of St Lazarus"}
skos:Concept.skos:scopeNote: {"id": "3fae7f93-20a4-40d2-8a55-af7805603542", "value": "A manor or estate owned and run by an order of knights and governed by a preceptor."}

{"id": "b4895550-76e5-4429-b0b1-bcd5d550c118", "value": "A reinforced concrete structure, which may be sited above ground or semi-sunken, from where it was intended to conduct the business of government from, in the event of nuclear war. Date specific to the early-mid 1950's."}

{"id": "1f104eb6-01cf-4bb1-bebf-5ba26a064d92", "value": "A structure, often sited underground, from where it was intended to conduct the business of government in the event of nuclear war. Sub RSGs were introduced between the RSGs and local authorities to allow the RSGs to focus on strategic direction."}

{"id": "5fa62811-52fa-4008-a4eb-17a82346e37f", "value": "A reinforced concrete structure, usually sited underground, from where it was intended to conduct the business of government in the event of nuclear war. Date specific late 1950's to early 1970's."}

{"id": "a8ab2747-4e0d-4079-b06f-f631d5b440e7", "value": "A reinforced concrete structure, usually sited underground, from where it was intended to conduct the business of government in the event of nuclear war. Date specific from mid 1980's to early 1990's."}
{"id": "6d029cf0-a7e5-4d11-9fa8-2fc81260f4cd", "value": "A pillbox built to a design drawn up by the commander of the Royal Engineers for the Colchester Garrison."}
{"id": "08aa96cc-73e8-45ec-aa52-a0972016287a", "value": "A small area of managed woodland, created to provide cover for foxes."}
{"id": "f8bc9cb9-9770-4b11-a722-3e104ca5d4d4", "value": "A building for housing deer overnight."}
{"id": "dfb1d5e0-259d-43c6-8548-cc71df412b15", "value": "A large park for keeping deer. In medieval times the prime purpose was for hunting."}
{"id": "535cab42-f9e4-4d5a-8847-587e01d49fb1", "value": "A house or range of buildings in which dogs are kept, eg. hunting hounds."}
{"id": "d1c86355-8ec1-432a-8b14-09227c6c25c8", "value": "A building used as a social venue by people interested in, and involved with, the sport of hunting."}
{"id": "8db8db5f-918e-4e0e-9484-7059de67d9f2", "value": "A small area of managed woodland, created to provide cover for deer and other game."}
{"id": "48d72ad1-5675-4438-9c7f-318b67462412", "value": "Structure used for viewing deer hunt."}

{"id": "f7291f11-6adb-41fe-8d65-e6b0916e48ff", "value": "An earthwork feature used by hunters to trap deer comprising a steep ditch into which the deer are chased with an enclosure to hold them at one end, known from the Isle of Rum and a debateable example in Cumbria."}
{"id": "ec2a2063-431f-43cf-bf06-9f684fb91ffc", "value": "A weekend retreat for Royal parties and others, when hunting in the Royal forests, or as a viewing station for the chase."}
{"id": "f695baa0-d45d-4bc0-af0a-a7067e11d518", "value": "An area of land, heavily though not totally covered with trees, set aside for the royal hunt by Norman and Plantagenet kings."}
{"id": "0b44a6e7-dcd8-4bf4-8eda-4080ac93f83b", "value": "Bank to let deer cross ditches, fences or roads, into, but not out of, a deer park."}
{"id": "15c2bb97-57dd-4ef3-abd5-7f27b1dda32d", "value": "A small building in which game is hung up and kept cool."}
{"id": "b489f27a-949a-4788-a015-f16f59ac273c", "value": "An enclosure used for corralling deer."}
{"id": "22d9a465-8c1c-41cf-84d8-6352f9e4f0b9", "value": "A building, site or structure associated with the hunting of animals."}
{"id": "6b5b7bf4-947d-43b0-b7d0-2c5b37a33ceb", "value": "A place where pheasants are reared and kept."}
{"id": "9c34dce7-19a3-4d40-9c0c-2b8b6618e3ec", "value": "A building used to shelter deer hunters."}
{"id": "269b4533-29e2-405e-b2b7-557cbd64efc5", "value": "A wooden stake fence, often associated with deer hunting."}
{"id": "970d9688-17ef-4a22-a2e6-d85a513080b0", "value": "An establishment or building where the breeding and training of birds of prey takes place."}
{"id": "95f8c27e-ffde-406d-b6c4-a3df292cb17a", "value": "Position often screened by earth, stone or wood from which game is shot."}
{"id": "64b29853-6761-40fd-b565-91e15b42c8e2", "value": "A building used for the shelter and protection of deer, especially in winter."}
{"id": "59b01e99-c1e0-447f-ac32-331b6c3fc31b", "value": "Term for ore store/ore hopper, used particularly in Yorkshire and Derbyshire."}

{"id": "0a46de77-2c83-407f-9772-76bb30b3b788", "value": "Accommodation used as an alternative to the workhouse following several Poor Law Acts. Modelled on continental examples and first erected at the end of the 1860s, it is based on the idea of a \"village\" of small houses accommodating a small group."}

{"id": "5a3639d4-5776-4d4e-a975-ee2fe03b1bb4", "value": "Name given to a workhouse after 1929. The Local Government Act of 1929 abolished Poor Law Unions and Guardians, and control passed to public assistance authorities run by county boroughs and county councils. Lasted until 1948 when poor laws were repealed."}
{"id": "fbe6ef91-96f1-4460-ada5-d14d3fa54dd7", "value": "A courtyard in a prison or workhouse for the inmates to take exercise."}

{"id": "bb94849e-6873-4b9e-a11d-9834e9449692", "value": "A 19th century establishment for the provision of work for the unemployed poor of a parish; later an institution administered by Guardians of the Poor, in which paupers are lodged and the able-bodied set to work."}
{"id": "cfa68558-32e1-4397-9246-19ceb61687e7", "value": "A place where inmates of a workhouse or prison carried out stone breaking."}
{"id": "35f3d6c8-2fdc-4eed-b739-575c0fe8b4ae", "value": "A wing in a workhouse to accommodate vagrants overnight."}

{"id": "a76ce0d7-bb7c-4abf-b012-066b82749659", "value": "A building as part of a workhouse, prison or hospital, often including porter's lodge, baths, clothes store, washrooms, casual cells, rooms etc, for receiving inmates/patients. Use term from Components thesaurus if it is part of a building complex."}

{"id": "4766a6a6-ede4-4e5d-bbc9-39c49f3872a3", "value": "A building used for the care of the sick. Only to be used where part of a complex, eg. a workhouse. In such cases use with appropriate monument type."}

{"id": "aea720ad-0e2a-4031-a3dc-ad8873b51e03", "value": "Nowadays a hospital where patients suffering from psychiatric disorders receive medical care and treatment. Traditionally they were often places where psychiatric patients were kept confined away from society receiving minimal medical care or attention."}
{"id": "c3741560-9de1-4df1-ba2d-d55168fc66dc", "value": "A chapel dedicated to our Blessed Lady, often placed to the east of the High Altar, sometimes in other positions."}
{"id": "b08048f0-3dc3-46aa-a9aa-c2fb9cb1088a", "value": "A building used as emergency accommodation and food distribution centre for people displaced by a natural disaster or conflict."}
{"id": "9db26fcc-1104-4f68-aee4-c6056857defc", "value": "A central point for the deposit, collection and recycling of waste materials."}
{"id": "d582e55b-ec69-4491-aea6-a8ffaeaf73f0", "value": "A fortified structure used to protect civilians and military personnel from enemy bombing."}

{"id": "c9afe8e2-4733-4272-8596-67c2f889f4c9", "value": "A structure, often concrete or brick, used as a shelter by members of the British citizen army during watch or patrol duties, or air raids, in wartime."}
{"id": "a7a8e613-c50b-45e7-bc9b-2839a6d91541", "value": "A place in which gunpowder and other explosives are stored in large quantities."}
{"id": "e94d070e-da3a-4270-89c4-d9e9c5b0335c", "value": "An explosive-proof vaulted chamber used for the storage or ordnance."}
{"id": "260a6255-9f9d-4e44-8f99-63139e7b04c9", "value": "A dispersed farmstead where buildings and yards (regular or loose courtyard in their form) are sited alongside a routeway."}
{"id": "159cd3c0-14ef-45ef-bd5f-46f39cadc495", "value": "A dispersed farmstead where the farm buildings and farmhouse are loosely grouped together within the boundary of the farmstead."}
{"id": "4d5fbb07-5ca1-4ebd-8552-58336f236f1f", "value": "A farmstead where the buildings and yards are loosely arranged, with no focal yard. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "bf7866bc-f0b8-4322-8aac-2140c39623a2", "value": "A dispersed farmstead where buildings are arranged around scattered yards which can be loose or regular in their form."}
{"id": "af52b096-6c31-4254-8a89-6760985a9c85", "value": "A natural ditch the depth and/or width of which has been increased so as to prevent the progress of a tank or armoured vehicle."}

{"id": "0554685b-a690-4793-b847-124b4c7edb3c", "value": "A cable repeater station for the undersea telephone and telegraph cables. Repeater stations compensated for the inadequacies of 1920's and 30's equipment over long distances, by repeating the signal every 200 miles."}
{"id": "235e29bd-a830-4553-a881-995f51fc3d67", "value": "A building housing one end of an underwater telegraph cable."}
{"id": "6454ea11-1036-4a97-8c05-1bb468cab1c2", "value": "A building used to coordinate civil defence in times of war. Can also be utilized as aid centres in times of national emergency."}
{"id": "9a5ed2a3-ed3a-4386-b5c0-e7aad7f54ed9", "value": "Place for the Home Guard to store equipment and amunition, either structural or subterranean during the defence of Britain."}
{"id": "b090a7d4-713d-4f8f-bf0b-027dbf1ca04e", "value": "A tunnel with strengthened construction, used as an emergency exit from a civil defence building."}
{"id": "d39f3ffc-48fa-4f44-9f34-6d9e4c9eaa12", "value": "An observation post used by members of the Home Guard."}

{"id": "9cdeaa47-59af-454b-b9c8-3c02e5577c1b", "value": "A structure, building or room within a building, used by a local authority for the continuance of local government in the event of a military or civil emergency."}
{"id": "7da83c26-fe45-4399-abbd-c50f4bcb2b9d", "value": "A building used for the daily administration of Civil Defence activities."}
{"id": "1d4e1724-6543-4a4f-b8a9-c7df31799af7", "value": "A building used as the headquarters for the Home Guard during the Second World War."}
{"id": "64774a5e-a7c4-49a3-821f-66d214705915", "value": "A garage for the storage and maintenance of motor vehicles, such as ambluances and fire engines, used for civil defence purposes."}
{"id": "2e159e4a-1f30-475a-8abe-79beb5fb4ad1", "value": "A prison for the confinement of people who owe money."}
{"id": "44b77286-a8eb-4dff-8e7a-87466d498715", "value": "An open market where cloth and other textiles can be traded."}
{"id": "f67988e3-dcbe-49b2-8c8e-3480403aa4e6", "value": "A market hall where cloth merchants can show their wares and conduct business."}
{"id": "69ec1dc5-71fd-44ca-a9f9-0f620f4c4c9b", "value": "A hospital department for the medical and surgical treatment of teeth disorders."}
{"id": "3aad5956-d0c3-4366-a50a-3e963f351925", "value": "A separate functional unit of a hospital not necessarily on the same site."}
{"id": "b7b35a3a-bdae-41ae-b633-ead29e682196", "value": "A hospital department for the medical treatment of eye disorders and diseases."}
{"id": "ded1289a-fbb3-4c85-985b-0d13cb8e528f", "value": "A hospital department where surgical and medical dental treatment takes place."}
{"id": "2b377f4a-b1ec-4e74-b03f-1f98d5ba49db", "value": "A hospital department, open 24 hours a day, for the immediate reception and treatment of emergency cases."}
{"id": "c5f45d80-f6fc-40f1-b1d5-a720662ead27", "value": "A hospital department for the identification and treatment of skin tissue disorders."}
{"id": "80793218-fd08-4671-97fd-aa10c8cb8d7e", "value": "A department devoted to the curing or correcting of physical deformities."}
{"id": "16996c19-2a19-4221-a324-34a12ba61312", "value": "A hospital department for the medical treatment of ear, nose and throat disorders."}

{"id": "41f7379b-7b77-44ac-8f2c-113b25c7df4a", "value": "A hospital department concerned with the reconstruction or repair of parts of the human body using transferred tissue, either in the treatment of injury or for cosmetic reasons."}
{"id": "c78caa5a-7d59-422b-a070-e17865ec0669", "value": "A hospital department which treats patients without keeping them in overnight or for a longer period."}
{"id": "a671c2ad-9604-4457-9dc4-6e83d24e251c", "value": "A hospital department where research and treatment into the causes and nature of diseases or abnormal bodily conditions is carried out."}
{"id": "d7767951-09cb-4c6a-bb32-722a9a740be5", "value": "A hospital department where heat, light, sound, electricity, etc, is administered to patients suffering from muscular or skeletal disorders."}
{"id": "19adf8c8-44ee-42ba-aa23-7e300034acfe", "value": "A place where patients have X-Rays taken to highlight an illness or irregularity."}
{"id": "18251364-3750-4cb1-8fa6-0abd027e9446", "value": "Shallow ditches and/or poles erected across open land to obstruct the landing of enemy aircraft and gliders."}
{"id": "e60078d1-acae-44a3-838d-ae2c5f4ba07e", "value": "Reinforced concrete blocks, walls or ditches designed to obstruct the progress of a tank or armoured vehicle."}
{"id": "5fbb664e-4c5f-432e-973c-036fc49784ae", "value": "A system of lights, controlled fires or dummy constructions, used during WWII to provide a counterfeit target for enemy aircraft."}
{"id": "e6aad7ab-94ae-4dfb-8a1c-74db5eb57ce9", "value": "Rolls of barbed wire with supporting metal posts designed to impede enemy advance."}
{"id": "3d49f161-6872-4324-8fa0-5e7b006c5c41", "value": "Stop-line against invading tanks in form of a ditch during the defence of Britain."}
{"id": "7b465026-bc8e-4750-b8dc-731b7cfa8835", "value": "An area of ground or water containing explosive mines."}
{"id": "8fcd7915-7581-4247-a727-1cdd84b21634", "value": "Sites and structures, often un-manned, intended to impede or confuse enemy forces."}

{"id": "8ad3d045-7475-4f2d-b087-7e9175bbe163", "value": "Obstacles such as scaffolding, barbed wire and concrete blocks or cylinders placed on a beach to impede the progress of enemy soldiers, vehicles or watercraft landing from the sea."}
{"id": "040adc96-a743-4554-8e7f-ff0caeceabe8", "value": "A pit filled with rocks and metal, designed to be fired with an explosive charge."}
{"id": "feae65fd-ce4b-4a7d-a3d2-2c207cc13684", "value": "A WWII structure designed to project sheets of flame across an area such as a beach, the sea or a road, to hinder attacking forces."}
{"id": "45d2bd4c-b4b8-4f69-ab17-ef620a9313b3", "value": "Smoke generators (also known as smoke pots) were used to create a smoke screen to provide defensive cover for strategic targets"}
{"id": "1c0c906a-9d8d-4088-bb8e-cb911a783bf4", "value": "A system of stones or wooden obstacles placed close together to impede the advance of enemy forces. Do not use for HILLFORT sites."}
{"id": "5eaf1fd7-ef8d-4924-8013-f3ca99cef849", "value": "A combination of obstructions, used either to stop enemy forces or force them off the road."}
{"id": "ea6d1685-9be8-485e-9a44-af5f82718e88", "value": "Obstacles like concrete cubes, cylinders or pimples erected in the defence of Britain."}

{"id": "b5617b9d-d574-4fc7-b35a-bd39db284a02", "value": "A site where a single large balloon was attached by fine wire cables to the ground to form an aerial obstruction to attacking enemy aircraft."}
{"id": "fe2951ad-b698-4101-8035-f7fedaa7a6d3", "value": "An indoor or outdoor market where leather and untreated animal hides are sold."}

{"id": "31cd64d3-90f6-4e0b-a41d-4e408f2f07a3", "value": "Originally an area planted with evergreens or winter-flowering plants for winter display, they can also be large glasshouses built for public entertainment where the original purpose of displaying plants has either disappeared or been minimalised."}
{"id": "7d5b2cc1-68fe-470e-9803-a1180a408dde", "value": "A building used by an organization or society instituted to promote research."}

{"id": "eafebe9b-7a5a-4d22-a803-fc711d57a764", "value": "A subscription club, usually with a library and newspaper room, established from c.1815-1860, their educational function gradually taken over by the public libraries in the later 19th century."}
{"id": "a15fa87c-d9b8-479d-9fc1-fa6ae8f02de4", "value": "A building used by an organization or society instituted to promote technology through lectures, research, etc."}
{"id": "01a5f011-eb23-4da9-ba57-d09d142f174f", "value": "An institute provided by a regiment for the improvement of the soldiers and to reduce excessive drinking."}
{"id": "1ad7cd34-1701-431e-94ee-f4095bf64ced", "value": "An establishment where deaf people receive education, training and social support."}
{"id": "9d69aab9-55f7-49c2-b764-813daab33ad4", "value": "A building where miners could improve their knowledge by attending lectures and using the reading room facilities."}
{"id": "0acee59b-a5fd-4cb0-af75-1505d55f9b69", "value": "A building for a society formed for the promotion of some branch of learning or science."}
{"id": "ad08b54a-7f14-4b4b-997d-b81fa4ed8aea", "value": "A building used by an organization or society to promote the study of oriental languages and history through lectures, research, etc."}
{"id": "e2b920a1-36c9-4074-8883-caa5a969b329", "value": "A place where working men could educate themselves through lectures and the use of a reading room with newspapers, etc."}
{"id": "949ba66a-2fad-4b01-bf62-6f866f851aea", "value": "An building, often including recreational facilities, provided for the relaxation of serving Royal Air Force Personnel."}
{"id": "dd751f93-2f3e-45b5-8cf4-6b017e5e28aa", "value": "A room in a library or institution providing periodicals, newspapers, etc."}
{"id": "033aea80-2c00-4038-abac-fb5529ea20af", "value": "A building in which an organization or society is instituted to promote foreign languages in England such as French and German, etc."}
{"id": "13386489-ab5b-4645-a7d0-16ba14d30b02", "value": "A building used by organizations or societies for the promotion of a particular profession through lectures, research, etc."}

{"id": "bc41a4ea-ab2d-49e4-8586-a2f5f4716a5d", "value": "A building used by members of the Womens Institute, an organization which meets regularly and engages in various social and cultural activities."}
{"id": "2fe477ce-0725-4cfc-a5e4-49741f75fcf0", "value": "A building used by the church to promote Christianity through lectures, study, etc."}
{"id": "b8d52f96-25e1-4a36-bcf3-57807c55683f", "value": "A building used by an organization or society instituted to promote the study of mathematics through lectures, research, etc."}

{"id": "de37c489-8b6f-4e61-b154-0e010a159518", "value": "A building in which a society or organization is instituted to promote science, art, literature, education, etc. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "00f99811-4502-4229-8b54-5ee9d40cacf7", "value": "A building used by an organization instituted to promote the needs and rights of the blind."}
{"id": "d75ca900-ebd2-4b56-8df0-7430790b7bb7", "value": "A way between different places, used by horses, travellers on foot and vehicles."}
{"id": "af6d0359-0005-415f-812d-0e63eb57c535", "value": "A passage or road closed to traffic at one end."}
{"id": "d8c85d79-7aa4-4d55-a440-9f85299f0b73", "value": "A Neolithic burial monument comprising a stone-built chamber within a mound of stones. Use more precise term where known."}

{"id": "5e37a221-24d4-458d-b5f0-276bacee6448", "value": "A form of Neolithic burial monument comprising a large circular stone or earthen mound, with a low and narrow entrance passage leading to a wider and higher stone built chamber."}
{"id": "e0476340-b6a5-47e5-9c90-a63ca708364c", "value": "A large shed for the housing of aircraft, etc."}
{"id": "18235c18-5a1a-4e37-906d-4d28da46c593", "value": "A hangar for the storage and maintenance of dirigible motor-driven balloons."}

{"id": "21818089-13b4-4ee9-8d82-93ee1089eab1", "value": "A representation in the round of a living being, allegorical personage, eminent person or animal, etc, sculptured, moulded or cast in marble, metal, plaster, etc."}
{"id": "cf59e79e-0f65-4d07-b411-ce5fa3048c14", "value": "A sculptured group comprising a chariot drawn by four horses."}
{"id": "735f0204-489c-4c6f-a540-bb66b601d3e1", "value": "An outlying farm or estate belonging to the Cluniac order."}
{"id": "29e3170f-8a72-41ee-9c62-090e151cd4c5", "value": "An abbey or priory of Cluniac monks."}
{"id": "81bc8a47-b607-46ec-9cd5-c43ab7711c94", "value": "An abbey or priory of Cluniac nuns."}
{"id": "603157ba-1942-4c4e-a527-6539a0554f65", "value": "A residence of two or three monks of the Cluniac order dependent on an English mother house."}
{"id": "2d809d03-56f1-415c-b30f-1fbc332445ad", "value": "The limit line of a parish."}
{"id": "20d9719a-042c-4399-bb9c-93cb7844eb41", "value": "A sculpted cross, or a cross incised into stone or trees, to mark a parish boundary."}

{"id": "80f4b986-e924-474f-acaf-2361925c9e72", "value": "Heavy anti aircraft battery used from June 1944-May 1945 to combat the V-bomb threat. They are distinct from normal HAA batteries, being laid out in a V-shape, and early on were mainly for mobile 3.7-inch guns."}
{"id": "296e4629-0526-49ee-942a-281402edbb25", "value": "An establishment open at night for refreshment and entertainment."}

{"id": "dd1c6eba-3dc3-4e9b-9b1c-e67038db4cdc", "value": "A circular pillbox designed by the Engineering and Metals Company using 'Armco' corrugated iron sheets as the inner and outer skins into which concrete was poured, giving a 12in wall thickness. The design was taken up by DFW and assigned a drawing number."}

{"id": "867adc9e-57cf-497b-a848-49459d0a2607", "value": "A pillbox in which the roof is detached from the walls and supported by a central pillar, thus leaving an embrasure allowing a 360 degree field of fire."}
{"id": "01dbd03e-f380-4eba-9b37-e83e0451717b", "value": "A pillbox built to a design drawn up by the chief engineer of GHQ home forces."}

{"id": "5721d5b9-ef31-42ce-939e-1e258cca3e67", "value": "A circular pillbox, usually consisting of a concrete pipe with a timber and corrugated iron roof, surrounded and covered by earth and sandbags. Built to a design by Norcon Ltd, a company dealing in concrete pipes."}
{"id": "41ea1adf-5795-499e-bf4a-eb23f57becb8", "value": "A pillbox built to a design drawn up the chief engineer of Scottish Command"}
{"id": "f1004fe0-7d81-4c09-a4f6-16c34c264274", "value": "A pillbox built to a design drawn up by the chief engineer of GHQ home forces."}

{"id": "62fef83a-1edb-4229-ba8c-7881c555ed56", "value": "A pillbox design, assigned a drawing number by DFW branch 3. Although originally believed to be a distinct type, FW3/45 has recently been found to be a design for modifications to existing types. Double index with specific type where known."}

{"id": "44986587-196d-45d5-8682-f1f9e5a1ae13", "value": "A pillbox which has been modified from a standard Directorate of Fortifications and Works design. Double index with specific type where known."}

{"id": "2326b95a-9502-44d2-9eab-e44f98c7bd96", "value": "A square pillbox with walls up to 48in thick, designed to emplace a 2 pounder anti-tank gun. A large opening in the back allowed the gun to be wheeled into position at the large embrasure in the front wall. Designed by DFW branch 3."}

{"id": "c43b3f48-fdfc-4248-8df2-21f4a8019950", "value": "A square pillbox with loopholes for four light machine guns with 18 in thick walls. Probably designed by DFW branch 3 although it may have been adapted from an external source as Southern Command correspondence refers to the type as 'Stento'."}
{"id": "f7993c83-ebde-4426-8a06-9bbf92634c42", "value": "A pillbox constructed for use in training exercises forming part of a simulated defensive position"}

{"id": "0522ddbd-ed8e-4129-9b23-226807e3a021", "value": "A hexagonal pillbox, with an internal anti-ricochet wall and loopholes for fives light machine guns and one rifle. Originally designed to have 15in bulletproof walls many were built with 42in thick shellproof walls. Designed by DFW branch 3."}
{"id": "91c58a89-66d3-46f8-a4b2-24ec487d016e", "value": "A rotating, domed, steel turret set over a circular pit used as a gun emplacement."}

{"id": "c473218b-2869-4d2b-9f51-b7c85fea6eb4", "value": "A pillbox design, assigned a drawing number by DFW branch 3. Although originally believed to be a distinct type, FW3/45 has recently been found to be a design for modifications to existing types. Double index with specific type where known."}

{"id": "4af9e12e-6d24-4eef-ba76-bd9f3ec67fa5", "value": "A hexagonal pillbox with an interanl anti-ricochet wall. The rear wall was lengthened to take two rifle loopholes in addition to the five light machine gun. Both 15in and 42in thick walls are common. Designed by DFW branch 3."}
{"id": "b33febdb-c90c-4121-8647-aa17f29079ed", "value": "A pillbox constructed of prefabricated concrete panels. Double index with specific type where known."}
{"id": "ae7c35f6-e2c9-4cdf-8c1a-3cff330466ff", "value": "A pillbox built to a design by the commander of the Royal Engineers for the Colchester Garrison."}
{"id": "a387e2b7-884c-480d-bc24-85e1954be3d8", "value": "A short trench used to protect troops or to provide defensive fire from, often dug for practice purposes."}

{"id": "e12c5a98-4de8-47cb-a7a2-f671408abcb6", "value": "A sunken, circular, concrete pillbox used on airfields. They remained flush with the surface to permit the free movement of aircraft but, if attack threatened, could be raised hydraulically or by a counterbalance, and manned to give covering fire."}

{"id": "3cfa8c13-5fd6-42f3-964b-43e7f28d59fe", "value": "A machine gun post designed by James Ruck constructed from hollow blocks and prefabricated concrete sheeting with loopholes allowing for a garrison of eight."}
{"id": "5c029e7e-4217-447f-ada4-1c6eb8f3bd37", "value": "A notional line of resistance defined by anti tank obstacles, pillboxes and gun emplacements."}

{"id": "44a2ca0a-8003-4f18-8c7e-ffca335b7321", "value": "A rectangular pillbox with an enclosed square plan section for three light machine guns and an adjacent open area housing a mounting for a light anti-aircraft weapon. Designed by DFW branch 3."}
{"id": "89edb765-3646-4e70-92da-303787f5e507", "value": "A large, rectangular pillbox based on the FW3/28 with the addition of a small infantry chamber to one side of the main gun chamber."}
{"id": "36a10d9c-7d85-41b5-8b57-42ef931311a3", "value": "A pillbox built to a design drawn up by the commander of the Royal Engineers in Southern Area (Taunton Line)."}
{"id": "fce0879c-d2b6-441a-bfac-b6a30c986b23", "value": "A pillbox which varies from standard designs."}
{"id": "e8b8755c-8471-411f-ac39-dda7821a81b7", "value": "Fixed or hardened installation for machine guns. Temporary soft installations are possible as well."}
{"id": "3d331fcf-6731-4b65-b80c-0b8815ad59b9", "value": "A pillbox built to a design drawn up the chief engineer of Scottish Command"}

{"id": "28f587ec-9317-4b57-b0f1-3532ef3e4d12", "value": "A system of defensive works such as anti-tank obstacles, ditches and pillboxes, designed to stop the advance of an enemy. Defence lines were constructed across and around strategic areas of ground and sites such as industrial towns."}

{"id": "e31eaa5a-f3fb-4634-8937-75268ea629c0", "value": "A large octagonal pillbox, with a projecting entrance, equipped with loopholes for eight light machine guns and a light anti-aircraft mounting sited in a central well which was accessed from inside the pillbox. Designed by DFW branch 3."}
{"id": "accbb083-6737-4d87-b6b7-629563c81d1c", "value": "A construction designed to look like a pillbox in order to deceive or confuse the enemy."}
{"id": "56e19f4d-ff3a-4b70-b822-7a11d2d5123c", "value": "A pillbox with walls that have been thickened to protect against shells. Double index with specific type where known."}

{"id": "5dfdd583-933c-4be9-b337-3f978a587fdf", "value": "A flatbed lorry with a concrete defensive position fitted on the back enabling the \"pillbox\" to be driven to where it was most needed in the event of an airborne force landing on the airfield."}

{"id": "19de2e89-f74b-4d8a-9c2c-de8102a45ff3", "value": "An often squat building with thick, loopholed walls and a flat roof, designed to accommodate a variety of weapons, usually strategically positioned to cover a vulnerable point in a defensive system. Many were built to standardized designs."}
{"id": "4896f25f-915b-481a-baf9-2cc4db5f916b", "value": "A pillbox built to a design drawn up by the Air Ministry. Usually found on or near airfields."}
{"id": "07a860d4-9924-4908-8407-0bc2a2030b77", "value": "A pillbox built to a design drawn up by the chief engineer of South-Eastern Command."}

{"id": "c2010255-8ce4-486c-aeef-42359af28577", "value": "A small concrete turret placed on top of a standard 4 ft. diameter concrete pipe sunk into the ground. Intended for use in defending road junctions, airfields and beach exits."}

{"id": "cc88ae3d-334f-4c58-9516-589c98ec40bc", "value": "A circular pillbox designed by the Croft Granite, Brick and Concrete Company, with six loopholes. With no roof or door access was gained through the roof."}
{"id": "f3e5a17f-0def-47c9-890e-4e8420185eb6", "value": "A building or site used for the storage and distribution of the essential logistical requirements of the Royal Navy."}
{"id": "7db52534-2ce6-4d28-a70a-f88777e66b63", "value": "A place where knitted fabrics and legware garments were manufactured."}
{"id": "3c1564ad-64a8-431d-b419-0f2f3635d207", "value": "The dwelling and workshop of a framework knitter."}
{"id": "62cab7d5-c160-4fb8-b8cd-3a2ed871ed29", "value": "An attic workshop for textile manufacture, usually weaving."}
{"id": "d228d7f9-8f6a-420c-b822-e5fabd8ee099", "value": "The residence and small-scale workshop of a hosier."}

{"id": "6988bee7-b691-474a-b80c-3840d484c8c3", "value": "An establishment serving coffee and other refreshments and inexpensive foods. Between the 17th and 18th centuries they were also meeting places for political discussions."}
{"id": "a3d9a738-90bc-4b90-9daf-8ca523ed8f84", "value": "An establishment where chocolate was available as a beverage."}

{"id": "a29b151b-f7f7-41e6-ad00-7367a681fce7", "value": "A building with a range of facilities for the exclusive use of its all-male membership. Rooms were often provided as offices or short term accommodation, and the club could be used for business or social gatherings."}
{"id": "9fc98286-7cd3-48f8-9db2-e75836153e3b", "value": "A place where current and former members of the armed services meet for social and recreational activities."}
{"id": "d75b8fdd-e388-4cf2-9753-917c89e5750a", "value": "A building used by an association of persons for social and recreational purposes or for the promotion of some common object."}
{"id": "56a841c7-16e3-4d74-9f0c-ef0b7b4470b9", "value": "A golf course, clubhouse and ancilliary buildings."}
{"id": "85f52416-ed1f-4e0e-b962-fee9db676647", "value": "A place provided for leisure-time activities of young people."}
{"id": "0aaff3c3-5436-4abf-b288-b7c181d0403a", "value": "Buildings and structures associated with a private aviation club undertaken as a leisure pursuit. Usually situated on or near an airfield."}

{"id": "da549f10-1d46-492d-9ec1-5b6f929327de", "value": "A building owned by a constituency political party which provides a meeting place for local political activities and also provides entertainment facilities for its members and guests."}
{"id": "a55143a6-cb8e-4c1f-8678-d95988ad2927", "value": "A building occupied by a club or commonly used for club activities."}
{"id": "afc0141e-a2d6-4c93-a077-25fa827bc503", "value": "A site containing a tennis court, changing facilities and a club house."}

{"id": "ed3f7812-5baa-4843-9744-5172497db28e", "value": "A building used as a social venue by people interested in, and involved with, the sport of rowing. An area of the building may be used for the storage of canoes, sculls etc. Often situated by a river."}
{"id": "2438ce5a-8206-4005-ba09-f091092cd808", "value": "A building, usually in a rural setting, with a range of facilities for the use of members."}
{"id": "dc5013ad-a058-4ef1-8b83-b21c8567d751", "value": "A building used as a social venue by people interested in, and involved with, the sport of sailing. Often situated by a MARINA."}
{"id": "0795620b-3ed9-4a4e-be3c-d1fcdd6ebc6b", "value": "A building with a range of educational and recreational facilities for the exclusive use of its all-female membership."}
{"id": "5a5f024c-0389-4918-a341-a21d0479f0b8", "value": "A building used by a group of people who meet socially to participate in activities, usually related to a particular interest or occupation."}

{"id": "799a9b07-0195-4288-9af9-f5789c69356e", "value": "A building where jazz music is performed. Often situated in small venues to afford the intimacy of the musicians performing in close proximity to the audience."}
{"id": "37e8c4c5-cac7-4519-8803-aae781dc667a", "value": "A club founded to provide education, relaxation, and recreation for working men."}

{"id": "09376a95-de4d-497a-ab28-dea2cf9c1efc", "value": "A prefabricated structure of cant sided lightweight timber wall sections bolted together. Externally the walls were clad with plasterboard covered with felt. Designed for use as barrack accommodation during WWII."}

{"id": "180100bc-4f08-4304-9188-19089cccf84f", "value": "Buildings used for the accommodation, welfare and recreation of servicemen, especially those serving in the Royal Air Force. Use only for buildings associated with military installations. For non-military, use DOMESTIC class and its narrower terms."}

{"id": "76f06269-9d8c-43ab-a9af-ababf135ef6f", "value": "A type of military building associated with military airfields, where air crews were briefed for missions. The room could be a seperate building or part of an operations block and are built of varying types of temporary brick or nissen hut constructions."}
{"id": "9ba9c3a3-0db0-4d20-acce-17cabcb05448", "value": "A centre used by the Territorial Army, the volunteer reserve of the British army."}

{"id": "b54781b3-0576-462a-858c-30c408e7c8e2", "value": "A concrete arched military hut constructed by pouring concrete over hessian cloth that had been stretched over a temporary steel framework. Semi circular in section usually with end walls of brick. Designed by the Waller Housing Corp in 1943."}
{"id": "c56fba57-1c05-4486-a6c9-4b76924f082f", "value": "A building of unknown purpose found at a military site. Use more specific type where known."}

{"id": "3b3db892-5720-4402-acc1-7062adcf9cd0", "value": "A prefabricated structure of standard lightweight timber wall sections bolted together. Externally the walls were clad with plasterboard covered with felt. Designed in 1940 for use as barrack accommodation."}

{"id": "280a0368-1bb2-4b59-97f2-10f7c2b11198", "value": "An ancilliary building or structure associated with a military base. Use only where exact function is unknown otherwise use more specific term."}

{"id": "7d65782c-929c-4343-8689-3bb8e3eb8025", "value": "A prefabricated temporary structure made of lightweight timber framed panels clad externally with corrugated iron sheets. Used during WWII as officers quarters. Possibly manufactured by Boulton and Paul Limited."}

{"id": "6efe9c69-7626-4d2d-94f5-d4d6ba2cc7c9", "value": "A prefabricated structure of a light timber frame with external weather boarded walls and a timber felt covered roof. They were used as barrack blocks during WWII. Manufactured by Magnet Limited."}

{"id": "c7e3e927-876e-4593-8196-4f68f5d92d68", "value": "A hut consisting of a frame of reinforced concrete posts into which panels could be slotted. Designed by the British Concrete Federation (BCF) during WWII."}
{"id": "9fdb6fff-144d-4882-8347-4fcdfff70df6", "value": "A room used for directing military operations and exercises."}

{"id": "2ddf9f89-a998-4c41-80f4-c5c9bda6a49d", "value": "A type of temporary military hutting used throughout WWII constructed of brick in 'stretcher bond' 4.5 inches thick with a light steel truss roof usually covered with corrugated asbestos sheeting. Used for accommodation, as gyms, training huts etc."}

{"id": "a74316b8-4f7c-48d8-89b4-5a341b1f318f", "value": "A prefabricated structure of reinforced concrete posts and beams with infillings of pre stressed concrete planks and felted slabs. Initially used for military barracks in WWII and later for civilian housing. Manufactured by the Orlit Company."}

{"id": "3ed255a9-0419-482b-a0bf-d90bbb8e1036", "value": "A prefabricated structure consisting of trough shaped asbestos sheets bolted together to form a seven sided building in section with end walls of rendered brick. Manufactured from 1942 by the Universal Asbestos Company for use as airfield accommodation."}

{"id": "1b68846e-db8a-495f-8a40-ec6786a62cb9", "value": "A prefabricated structure consisting of six curved asbestos cement sheets that were bolted together, without a frame, creating a hut semi-circular in section. Used on airfields during WWII and manufactured from 1942 by the Turner Asbestos Company."}

{"id": "9a5cbdf2-62b4-485e-a2df-a50147d2115c", "value": "A prefabricated timber structure similar to Sectional hutting that was used by the Air Ministry for accommodation at airfields during WWII. Manufactured by Gerrard and Sons from 1939 to 1941."}

{"id": "8d9fcd11-564e-4c01-a211-28ee1cf6a9d1", "value": "A prefabricated structure consisting of sectional timber framed units that were bolted together. The structure was clad with Canadian Cedar weatherboarding and had a roof of corrugated asbestos. They were used as temporary accommodation on airfields."}

{"id": "111e133f-93d6-49de-8382-9e4a400218e4", "value": "A concrete hut produced by the Ministry of Works as a cheaper alternative to the BCF Hut as any suitable wall cladding could be employed in its construction. Usually used to form barrack blocks on airfields from 1944 onwards."}

{"id": "7ee37662-9536-48c6-ae75-7f7bc05a2d93", "value": "A prefabricated structure of cellular hollow plywood 'aero' beams and columns clad with timber framed units of flat asbestos facing sheets and a felt roof. Designed as airfield accommodation that could be reused as post WWII emergency housing."}
{"id": "7f7843d5-2612-418f-ac61-ddcc0cc98c17", "value": "A building of varying designs intended for directing military aviation operations. Normally associated with military airfields."}

{"id": "2529780e-6bc0-41b9-b31d-4c60baa2f15b", "value": "A prefabricated structure of reinforced concrete posts supporting a pitched roof frame with an infilling of sawdust concrete panels. Produced by Maycrete Ltd during WWII."}

{"id": "45c96ac3-146c-4b34-a8a1-9c418360579a", "value": "A prefabricated structure of a steel frame clad in corrugated iron. Semi-circular in section they were used as accommodation for the armed forces and, during WWII, as emergency housing for bombed out civilians. Also used for storage."}

{"id": "ef8cf248-2e4a-425a-86f4-fc47a26efb8b", "value": "A prefabricated structure of reinforced concrete posts supporting a pitched roof frame with an infilling of concrete panels. Produced by during WWII as barrack accommodation and as emergency housing. Similar in style to Maycrete huts."}

{"id": "231ec11a-5c76-43e2-8588-7eb8606926e1", "value": "A lightweight prefabricated structure of corrugated galvanized steel having a semicircular cross section. The design was based on the Nissen hut developed by the British during the First World War."}

{"id": "717f6a43-9fa9-4a4d-8ddb-48d300b96c2c", "value": "A prefabricated structure of a steel frame clad in corrugated iron. Semi-circular in section they were used for storage and as workshops, cinemas etc during WWII. Designed at Romney House, London by the Directorate of Fortifications & Works."}
{"id": "6c67071b-e1cb-4875-a264-10e67faab851", "value": "A long, low-rise building consisting of rows of attached individual suites of rooms used for overnight accommodation by motorists."}
{"id": "519a31ea-8322-4f31-b2d0-1e1f1157d336", "value": "The public house was a 19th century development, distinctive from the earlier BEER HOUSE by its decorative treatment and fittings."}
{"id": "af84337e-2e91-458b-9e74-979a5a533550", "value": "A hostel for packhorse teamsters."}
{"id": "daed5dc7-998b-4dc6-8812-44613fdfa15d", "value": "A type of Roman lodging house, frequently sited near the town gate."}
{"id": "e2ab8670-e4d3-43e2-afd6-36aa37cbc585", "value": "A public house for the lodging and entertainment of travellers, etc."}

{"id": "b8814a52-1be5-4ca2-8266-1ad8a3b82c19", "value": "An inn, with an integral courtyard, for the lodging and entertainment of travellers. Often with open galleried wings overlooking the courtyard."}
{"id": "67e380d5-4472-4ce8-88d7-2d6f47033bc0", "value": "A building or area within a brewery where barrels of ale are stored."}
{"id": "db197213-a50b-4a78-bf93-16ede5e7bf87", "value": "A building where beer was sold or displayed."}
{"id": "02c9c2f1-d7e8-402a-a537-6f7e18f3dc66", "value": "A building licensed for the sale of beer."}
{"id": "d58683bf-665f-463f-ac65-74516b9c887e", "value": "A large building used for the accommodation of paying travellers and guests."}
{"id": "7d7dcf73-bfa7-4385-a2bd-5683352928ff", "value": "Establishments authorized to sell or allow the consumption of alcoholic liquors on their premises."}
{"id": "06be5101-3ba0-41ff-b861-5b24ec3b95c4", "value": "A prehistoric coffin made out of a hollow tree trunk."}
{"id": "2313bd2f-27ca-4fdf-9ba6-da5f09f33c30", "value": "A chest made of stone, wood or lead, used to enclose a dead body."}
{"id": "8af1645a-8237-4c6e-a868-0c183fefb565", "value": "A stone coffin embellished with sculpture."}
{"id": "e4c0295a-2683-452b-a283-99374e72c0ff", "value": "A place where dockyard craftsmen both design and build ships."}
{"id": "f626b78d-c089-4788-bf6d-a1f54049ffa3", "value": "A site containing slipways and associated buildings used specifically for the repair of ships and larger ocean-going craft."}
{"id": "2b33e4d6-fbee-43bd-ae84-79f67a4d3f0d", "value": "A garden with real or supposed Swiss features, including buildings and plantings."}
{"id": "cbfc9273-40c3-4c34-a23c-1fd480b50dcd", "value": "A decorative or ornamental structure purposefully situated in a garden. Such as sculptures, sundials, bird baths, gnomes etc."}
{"id": "c9f5ef0a-bda4-4dd7-8a45-5a374cc20139", "value": "An informal garden attached to a cottage where flowers, vegetables and fruit trees are grown."}
{"id": "5979e2e1-1895-42ca-921b-515a907a616f", "value": "A garden with one or more platforms with walks, often on different levels, usually close to the house."}
{"id": "bf88462f-078e-4a65-8b24-a935407e4cb2", "value": "A 19th century Tudor revival garden."}
{"id": "016992f2-8887-430e-8cb8-4a39c6df8c73", "value": "A peat-based garden where various types of heather are grown."}
{"id": "49a5acea-10e0-4667-9cdb-cce45621c977", "value": "A garden created within woodland where imported species such as camellias, magnolias and rhododendrons are grown."}
{"id": "b125d904-dbe2-4100-8edb-e9357bb7a31b", "value": "An arboretum devoted mainly to the growing of conifers."}
{"id": "a5ae3f23-b42f-417f-8199-44d73553abd2", "value": "A garden for the cultivation of herbs used for medicinal or culinary purposes."}
{"id": "e0f1cf90-ac92-4698-8266-454e43d1bb0f", "value": "A refreshment house in a public park or country house garden."}

{"id": "2ee64907-ae30-4eb6-bb34-6eb6d48c8e10", "value": "A decorative garden, often landscaped, laid out with intricate flower beds and hedges, and often containing ornate sculptures, fountains and garden ornaments."}
{"id": "48cf2d39-46fa-4f2c-b4b6-03d475dc3338", "value": "A soft, marshy garden, often peat-based where water- and peat-loving plants are grown."}
{"id": "0311d833-90b5-476b-9b06-a43b6acd67f9", "value": "A type of 18th century public park, with refreshment houses, concert rooms, etc."}
{"id": "d54e24a5-cc49-41fb-bfdd-f9f9bf1e233b", "value": "A garden or collection of potted plants on the flat roof of a house or other building."}
{"id": "0b489f35-668b-4f75-9f0c-276722d8a686", "value": "An often secluded garden set below the level of surrounding ground, usually surrounded with terraces."}

{"id": "cadcf0eb-c1fb-4be3-a490-1fefac8b299f", "value": "A garden incorporating features of traditional Japanese gardens - a pool, an island, stepping stones or a bridge, cherry trees and other shrubs and flowering plants grown with the emphasis on line."}
{"id": "9c37d0bb-9f20-445f-be12-e28a48fa23d8", "value": "A small-scale garden."}
{"id": "afa6fe94-3a3b-4088-8f3d-5b56e45cb011", "value": "A garden in which flower beds are the primary focal point."}

{"id": "facec739-8240-42f7-9889-b1eac07f600a", "value": "A 17th century garden in the Dutch style: usually flat and compact, with an emphasis on small canals, hedges, topiary, lead statuary and flowering shrubs and bulbs."}

{"id": "36aead87-e700-4910-8217-50a6f8edb2e4", "value": "A building made chiefly of glass, used to grow plants and fruit in. Use more specific type where possible."}

{"id": "be567da8-0d73-43f2-8f7a-4c35517bb5e4", "value": "A forcing house used for various types of fruit which first appeared in the 19th century. Lean-to houses were used for wall-grown fruit and free-standing houses for fruit grown in pots or for trees planted in the ground."}
{"id": "0d48e26a-a821-42c3-9982-f573b8ce7025", "value": "A 19th century glasshouse built specifically for the fostering of camellias."}
{"id": "357492ba-a2ac-4575-b59d-c790e1050bfc", "value": "A glass-house or hot-house constructed for the cultivation of a grapevine."}
{"id": "f1702b61-8c9b-4034-83e4-8b450ebf81d1", "value": "A glasshouse for the cultivation of ferns."}

{"id": "1c549a6a-ffed-4ba3-b55b-e715d1d24a25", "value": "A cathedral in which the chapter was composed of canons who lived in their own houses and were not governed by a monastic rule. Nine such cathedrals existed in England between the 11th and 16th centuries."}
{"id": "fa16f267-e6a8-494d-81dc-48008f87b371", "value": "A building used for the storage of artillery pieces."}
{"id": "dbdc028f-b89c-4ff2-a95a-a319d2a5b096", "value": "A school where theological subjects are taught."}
{"id": "7e316c7c-6eb5-481f-bba7-f3ecdaaf0059", "value": "An establishment dedicated to the study of theology and religious training."}
{"id": "75538bae-edcc-4168-956f-27e4688c043e", "value": "A place where sand is extracted from surface workings."}
{"id": "903fe1fb-e6a9-43df-b715-d59500149995", "value": "A place where abrasive mediums such as sand-paper and grinding wheels are manufactured."}
{"id": "b2f119d9-af91-4ac3-b013-1fdb33821098", "value": "An outdoor or indoor place where flowers were sold."}
{"id": "1810475d-e738-4a21-9f9e-ba14c77abf30", "value": "A hall built as a memorial to a particular person or event."}

{"id": "c1b74da7-834e-49c5-89c3-88369085910d", "value": "A pass, vulnerable to attack from the enemy but essential for the movement of troops and which, if captured, could divide a defending force. As a result such passes are defended with anti invasion defences such as pillboxes."}

{"id": "8c3939be-20d3-4417-923c-f4c77e7608c7", "value": "A site used for the placing of an explosive, demolition charge. Many types of structures were prepared for demolition in the event of an invasion in order to cause the maximum disruption to the advance of hostile forces. Use more specifc type where known."}
{"id": "ee243831-2b93-4f36-b50a-f5d0987d519e", "value": "A site intended for use by the Auxiliary Units (or British Resistance Organisation) in the event of an invasion. Use more specific term."}
{"id": "8dccf2ca-4151-4ecb-afa8-ed6cd40a2486", "value": "An area, with fixed defences, designed to act as a focal point for a defending force."}

{"id": "121ef4f7-979f-4477-b453-4e288ddaaf51", "value": "Obstacles, often semi permanent, which are placed on railway lines to prevent the enemy from using them. Set up during the defence of Britain."}
{"id": "f7b30847-f302-4313-9c3d-cbcb8a1ddb37", "value": "Second World War defence work usually consisting of securinng points for a boom defence, associated gun, and searchlight, emplacements"}
{"id": "0bf68c7b-c8ae-440f-93de-ed22f9db7e16", "value": "Sites, buildings and structures associated with the prevention of an invasion by a hostile force."}

{"id": "7a296ea9-0803-40b4-bba7-e16bad39d1df", "value": "An area, often a village, with fixed defences such as pillboxes, anti tank ditches and gun emplacements, designed to stop the advance of an enemy force and to hold out for an agreed period of time."}

{"id": "2dbac134-487c-4b85-98c4-3c210b88a063", "value": "A designated area, usually sited at a strategic crossroads, with fixed defences such as pillboxes, anti tank ditches and gun emplacements, designed to act as a rallying point for defenders."}
{"id": "d1ccd495-b3a1-4317-b3fe-c890bb61e15b", "value": "A fortified river or river bank forming part of the anti invasion infrastructure."}
{"id": "8289ab0d-b00c-48d6-a87a-67fb52f4f246", "value": "Obstacles placed in open spaces and alongside roads designed to prevent the successful landing of enemy airborne forces."}

{"id": "24dfcc59-27fd-4cd8-b62a-fde162ae0f9c", "value": "A site, usually including fuel tanks, pipe works and control buildings, where flaming petroleum was intended to be used as a weapon against a hostile invasion."}
{"id": "a49e71fd-1851-484f-b52e-793ab9d0b9de", "value": "Submerged obstacles to stop the landing of Seaplanes"}

{"id": "3548a62c-2f97-4c71-b8f4-25229ef8ff73", "value": "A designated area within a town or village with fixed defences such as pillboxes, anti tank ditches and gun emplacements, designed to threaten the flanks of an enemy force which had broken through a stop line."}
{"id": "6f2565ff-3c38-4659-89f6-902419f84089", "value": "A storage facility used for the accommodation and dispersal of vehicles. Often used by the military and emergency services."}
{"id": "cc674fdb-0349-43bb-a45a-27624650a4ab", "value": "A building used for the storage of explosives of a non-military function, eg. mining explosives, signal explosivres etc."}

{"id": "f4f6b4ad-a757-4547-a58e-f9124061a2a1", "value": "A building or group of buildings, often enclosed by a system of fortifications, used by an armed force for the storage and distribution of military equipment."}
{"id": "60ac2657-44cb-4b45-8420-2f8a5291963d", "value": "A military depot where horses were taken and trained for service in the army."}

{"id": "7a848340-d4a3-49f6-85e6-61124e33ba35", "value": "Any military base where the depot battalion of a regiment is based. Depot battalions maintain the stores and records of a regiment and train new recruits."}
{"id": "7fc8ea69-56da-465f-a467-e8ba24fc3009", "value": "A building or site used by the armed forces for the storage and issuing of military stores and materials."}
{"id": "d91a853a-8467-4259-9c4a-5f4fcc382e87", "value": "An inclined plane built to allow tanks to be loaded and unloaded between rolling stock on the railway network and vehicular low loaders."}
{"id": "e99c53f2-0591-4c99-8517-c355bce14082", "value": "A building used to store military equipment and ammunition."}
{"id": "8aa278a1-651e-48ea-9244-6fe97cf49e26", "value": "A building or site used for the storage and distribution of the essential logistical requirements of an armed force."}
{"id": "c89b7f70-0cd6-4e3b-a2bf-a1a40650083d", "value": "An installation used to store ammunition and equipment ready for the mobilization of armed forces in the event of a war."}
{"id": "f1dd6e8d-20d2-4e29-b085-c1e31485ec84", "value": "A building or site used for the storage and distribution lighter than air gases for use in barrage balloons."}
{"id": "a3be5a3f-709d-4f3d-9fca-aae669947e42", "value": "A factory or works used for the production of turpentine, wood alcohol and similar chemicals by the distillation of pulped wood."}
{"id": "d96e1516-f4dd-4d37-b7d8-0df8b446bdbd", "value": "A site used for the separation of oil into its constituent parts by heating in an enclosed vessel(s)."}
{"id": "8bfb6a91-9c44-47aa-b949-5258d7c73bcb", "value": "Building housing the machinery for the shredding and grinding of wood in running water and pressing of the resulting fibres into a pulp."}

{"id": "ddbf5952-3a20-44a2-8640-9cde64513c94", "value": "A mill used to process logwood, the inner red wood of a South American tree used widely in dyeing. Imported in the form of logs and cut and ground into dye by a mechanical process."}
{"id": "4fd14ad6-268e-4cda-a51a-9e2287a7cd7a", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the production of charcoal."}

{"id": "c43ea7bf-1722-48bb-bdab-54ee28925e7a", "value": "A works using sealed retorts to produce charcoal. Wood distillates may be produced as byproducts of this process. They may be found at separate works or comprise part of a gunpowder works."}
{"id": "d439bf07-a826-4668-87be-2132703f7e32", "value": "A building where distillation, a chemical process used in the production of a range of different chemicals, took place."}
{"id": "1eda645d-d0a6-4753-938c-13b3d58f2835", "value": "A factory where aircraft engines are assembled."}
{"id": "36936d65-9436-4a71-a1b7-2dbaddfb356a", "value": "A workshop used for completing the shape of a product or part by turning on a lathe or wheel."}
{"id": "68fb1d87-1118-417b-a044-1a98bc1c35b5", "value": "A factory where aircraft are assembled."}
{"id": "6fb92d46-d83e-496b-b771-8cc4386247e6", "value": "A structure which can be an area within a building, a separate building within a complex or a detached architectural component of a building"}
{"id": "16621626-1456-4845-b34f-ba470969b4e9", "value": "A construction of unknown function, either extant or implied by archaeological evidence. If known, use more specific type."}
{"id": "f0da4bde-e2d1-4edf-b659-1db627c1b8c4", "value": "Building or buildings housing equipment for generating heat for a building complex."}
{"id": "a39cd27c-6132-43fb-8b5d-50877bd143d9", "value": "A tall, multi storeyed building either used as business premises or, more usually, as residential accomodation."}
{"id": "ab48be49-6f93-4af4-96d0-80522152be73", "value": "A structure with a roof to provide shelter from the weather for occupants or contents. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "169f3fb6-9d75-43ad-91ab-ee2618d093d9", "value": "A small building used by a gatekeeper."}

{"id": "cf47ce93-8acf-47c2-b02b-9795490c5c9e", "value": "A slight structure built for shelter or storage, or for use as a workshop, either attached as a lean-to to a permanent building or separate. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "f2d6d3c2-be97-40de-b426-227532a4439f", "value": "A detached subordinate building. Use specific type where known, eg. DAIRY."}
{"id": "4e140f2e-03f1-463d-882f-307832b8c77b", "value": "Prefabricated small building that is designed and built to be movable rather than permanently located."}
{"id": "e16c9abc-671c-4387-b7dd-0ec3300eba8c", "value": "A small building used by the keeper of a castle, park, etc."}
{"id": "ba72759c-5163-4684-a771-1e6a5b55ffca", "value": "A building in which goods or items are stored. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "dadc5b44-6abe-447e-a7cf-6af2a21c8b5c", "value": "Coastal base for the docking, launch and maintenance of submarines."}
{"id": "0ebc4e58-598d-483d-a4cf-0fcfea7d9fc4", "value": "A military base for the training of SOE operatives in the skills and techniques required to survive in enemy-occupied territory."}

{"id": "734c4fa7-ae67-4a96-8530-42bcb1d4e33b", "value": "A site, usually with docks and control buildings, used for the storage, maintenance and deployment of military vessels or the administration of the Royal Navy. May also include accommodation buildings for personnel."}

{"id": "298995e2-0786-42db-9f8c-5833c9d3b6f4", "value": "A site or building used for the storage and maintenance of both land and sea vehicles and from which terrestrial or maritime operations could be carried out."}
{"id": "6d288c2f-3e4e-4e2c-aa25-923e977a7413", "value": "A building used as the command centre of a military operation."}

{"id": "d8fa95d2-3ae8-4e7d-a838-633b0ebf0af3", "value": "A site, usually with an airfield, hangars and control buildings, used for the storage and deployment of military aircraft or the administration of the Royal Air Force. May also include accommodation buildings for personnel."}
{"id": "99e427ab-a3a7-4921-af0c-f1b53e37ce03", "value": "A military base used for training service personnel."}

{"id": "6feab73a-c698-4a94-8b0b-f7ece08accba", "value": "A building or group of buildings, often surrounded by a system of fortifications, used as a residential and training site by members of an armed force."}
{"id": "fb8cbb3e-1efc-4b56-9652-949a4b7e862e", "value": "An RAF Base, used specifically for the storage and maintenance of barrage balloons."}

{"id": "6d5d1528-3aec-4cbf-a048-8f569850b425", "value": "Sites used for the accommodation, welfare and recreation of servicemen, especially those serving in the Royal Air Force. Use only for sites associated with military installations. For non-military sites use DOMESTIC class and its narrower terms."}
{"id": "b06e118f-efde-417e-86ff-d018b491f2a0", "value": "The residence of a lifeboatman."}
{"id": "72527c8a-faa2-4a72-9398-235841517712", "value": "An engineering works producing items for the railway other than rolling stock, such as signals, tracks, points, etc."}
{"id": "9e989338-edb6-4be6-8342-6c587f10fcc6", "value": "A burial site for animals."}

{"id": "41827c73-6427-4b71-ac26-dfd8bb0cbb76", "value": "A burial ground for followers of the Islamic faith."}
{"id": "864b096b-404b-447c-8952-8263858494f0", "value": "A place of burial for members of the French Protestant Church."}
{"id": "c49a8a25-fac1-4f88-92bc-1184c657b90d", "value": "A burial ground for followers of the Eastern Orthodox church."}

{"id": "e9ba88c8-a3f4-432e-ae0d-b6e41a8820ce", "value": "An area used for the deposition of human remains where the principal funeral rite is the burial of the corpse complete. Generally indicated by the discovery of articulated human skeletal remains, occasionally with evidence of coffins and/or grave goods."}
{"id": "2bcaef5c-fb23-42bb-b87f-e719b72e8707", "value": "A burial ground for military personnel."}
{"id": "4032bd46-6cb7-403f-8f54-9f73f1016f77", "value": "A burial ground for followers of the Jewish faith."}
{"id": "23ae903c-ce87-472a-be5b-0ad0178ae4af", "value": "An interment of unburnt, articulated human remains. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "9aacbb14-f80a-407c-9526-296f524288ce", "value": "A burial ground for victims of the plague."}
{"id": "a41e78b0-8f2d-4118-9d14-4e8c4b0eea39", "value": "A burial ground for Roman Catholics."}
{"id": "3823c69d-98e2-42ac-b25b-11e6007e0de5", "value": "A place of burial. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "2f9b2eed-c35c-459a-85d4-6e700b0b40c1", "value": "A stone placed over or at the head or foot of a grave, or at the entrance of a tomb."}
{"id": "e1842610-292e-4793-9985-cef1692dd89b", "value": "A horizontal stone placed across a grave."}
{"id": "7754265a-6433-4b9b-b4e0-789cb86aec61", "value": "A Jewish graveyard headstone."}
{"id": "70a805e9-bd8d-4d8c-92a5-ed5990f2cd7d", "value": "For the storage and recharging of battery-powered miners lamps."}
{"id": "52a34610-7e54-4676-9129-66ec3e67c391", "value": "A building containing the colliery showers. Also often containing first aid and mine rescue facilities."}
{"id": "5af21e20-e003-4dca-8cd5-c6e3e4d036f3", "value": "A circle of wooden stakes or stake holes in the ground."}

{"id": "9fe7c774-9b25-44e5-84a6-586ee6585be8", "value": "Land which has been temporarily taken over for use by the military or civilian authorities. During wartime land was requisitioned for various purposes, such as for argriculture or for military training/events etc."}
{"id": "c8bdb918-e853-4a38-8c02-c8e452c00566", "value": "A pound for the accommodation of livestock."}
{"id": "9be31702-0ca2-40ce-ac42-5f1bddf9100f", "value": "Ornamental wrought iron screen associated with gate lodges or entrance lodges."}
{"id": "e8d01885-d0bc-4577-96a0-73f6fcaf970d", "value": "A yard or enclosure attached to a farmhouse, usually surrounded by other farm buildings."}
{"id": "6f092bae-3ec5-4360-8667-ddcd8926b56b", "value": "A pillow-shaped, flat topped rectangular mound often surrounded by a shallow ditch used to farm rabbits."}
{"id": "942dc226-e523-4a7f-aa96-569fa1acc8fb", "value": "An artificial pond or pool constructed for the purpose of watering livestock, particularly in prehistory."}
{"id": "cf82c7e4-ed46-42ab-912a-d06bbe8bdaa2", "value": "Stone for holding ox yokes."}
{"id": "c6bfdff5-367e-4346-b0e4-e295e7353f2e", "value": "A yard for pigs."}
{"id": "039d4028-e09c-490b-94b0-f4d8489d8037", "value": "A small circular enclosure defined by a turf or earthern bank."}
{"id": "52b5133b-cebb-4969-9d3d-d85280ca34d7", "value": "Manmade marks or earthworks which provide evidence for agricultural cultivation."}
{"id": "a814d400-74ad-4db2-a487-7c1b29367f8c", "value": "A small enclosure for cattle, sheep, swine, poultry, etc. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "8ddcc114-32d9-4d2e-9f4f-a5579598f02a", "value": "Term applied to both the pit trap itself, and the walled enclosure containing pit trap(s)."}
{"id": "c1be8921-c3cd-4c5f-a495-0c15252aecf3", "value": "A building used for an agricultural and/or subsistence purpose. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "50989d6b-371f-49fc-9c1e-10c356f18032", "value": "A structure used to dry turf on. Turves were used as a fuel and as a roofing material."}
{"id": "c47a0d8c-eebc-4981-8495-07b809216090", "value": "A small stone structure, usually at a spring or bog, in which dairy products were kept cool on slate shelves."}
{"id": "aa4a8779-06ca-4692-a295-05b2366fd8ad", "value": "A wall in a flower or kitchen garden, containing conduits or pipes for heating the wall."}
{"id": "fdd5b5bb-f081-47ca-a837-a51d78df5d67", "value": "A small park or enclosure where animals are kept."}
{"id": "a401dd03-ef16-47a1-828c-2cfae40fc2dd", "value": "A pit used for containing manure."}
{"id": "b5854633-e4fb-440a-84de-12223933df63", "value": "A monastic cattle ranch with associated buildings, paddocks and pastures."}

{"id": "b3cffccd-08f5-419e-9eb8-02b2b3c97592", "value": "A monument consisting of a small (generally less than 100m diameter) subcircular enclosure with a narrow approach way consisting of parallel ditches (thus banjo shaped). Believed to be associated with stock management in the Later Prehistoric period."}
{"id": "ce7979fa-6c73-4e2b-ab78-2215b20dbbd9", "value": "A wooden or stone plinth for depositing milk churns on."}
{"id": "01f5fa66-f846-4e46-82ef-3447bf2c7dc0", "value": "A building or area where stone is stored for industrial or agricultural use."}
{"id": "a15dcfe1-b22a-4ce6-8a23-e6b210bd2cd0", "value": "An area of land, usually enclosed, set aside for the breeding of hares."}

{"id": "216beec8-21e9-442e-8b46-d5687c432bd2", "value": "Sites, buildings, structures, features and areas of land associated with cultivation, the rearing of livestock, gathering, hunting & fishing. Includes farm based processing of foodstuffs & storage of agricultural produce."}

{"id": "f4a2f595-e7d0-4d33-b671-cdbe9b8e9516", "value": "A substantial area of ground surrounded by slight univallate earthwork often interpreted as stock enclosures or as sites where agricultural produce was stored."}
{"id": "76588edd-97f3-4974-acc2-258ec744ecb2", "value": "A stone-lined pit in which seaweed was burnt. The calcined ashes were used in the manufacture of soap and glass, amongst other things."}

{"id": "7ae8763e-3250-42fb-b310-ff057d36c6fa", "value": "A Palaeolithic or Mesolithic temporary site where there is evidence to suggest animal butchery. Evidence may include animal remains and a specialized tool assemblage."}
{"id": "29d11a54-53ba-48eb-91f8-e34b89603fc2", "value": "A pit used to trap game. Often originally covered and consealed, and sometimes with sharpened stakes in the base."}
{"id": "b7800095-a9ba-4649-8333-4174e5b266be", "value": "A platform for storing winter fodder."}
{"id": "263fb177-6df5-4c0b-8283-bb3f721b39e0", "value": "An area of hardstanding to allow movement of farm transport in all weathers."}
{"id": "7fad9b5a-aa9a-459b-af1c-89446a507819", "value": "A usually south-facing wall used for the cultivation of fruit plants."}
{"id": "1ac38399-8be1-47fb-91e7-ce222f163bca", "value": "A three-sided structure for the production and storage of silage."}
{"id": "910b0a4e-5294-4e93-aafa-65032cdc19cc", "value": "A device used to trap or kill animals considered to be pests, eg. rats."}

{"id": "8566722f-70b5-4485-bf21-4eb3aa0d6fd3", "value": "An irregularly constructed, generally unstructured, mound of stones. Often, but not necessarily, circular. Normally a by product of field clearance for agricultural purposes."}
{"id": "cb8f6aeb-8900-49c2-b50a-cf9201a6133d", "value": "A place where swans are bred and reared."}
{"id": "0aa0011b-f3dc-40c7-8459-719e4a0a8920", "value": "A frame used to lift unco-operative horses off the ground during shoeing."}
{"id": "355dfeeb-83ba-4178-b5ce-93223988657d", "value": "A wall built to give shelter to sheep."}
{"id": "7aab8fce-3f1e-4a35-8dbf-54e723d81454", "value": "Large semi-subterranean feature often packed with straw for the storage of potatoes and other root crops."}
{"id": "87030b1c-946a-4038-ad11-c52ed59c044e", "value": "Term applied to a pit trap itself and also a walled enclosure containing one or more pit traps."}
{"id": "ee369996-9bb5-4ab4-a7eb-0d0e48a20c32", "value": "An area used for the breeding and rearing of rabbits."}
{"id": "f8c8c251-b096-4d31-8393-76a7daa53622", "value": "A farmyard or enclosure containing regularly built stacks of hay, corn, peas etc."}
{"id": "42cc05cc-5e35-48bd-a3ac-6a27dcc3efa5", "value": "A pen, often circular and stone-walled, for rounding up livestock."}
{"id": "314692d2-3a3c-43bd-8873-5dffaa6c8ce0", "value": "Open yard for keeping cattle in during winter. Used from the mid-14th century in drier, Eastern, arable counties."}
{"id": "a932cddb-0372-4175-bd4a-2f7731c46638", "value": "A room or building in which riding tackle is stored."}
{"id": "dde6090d-c0d2-4850-9b7d-d1216802f9b3", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the farming of fish."}
{"id": "3b27c639-61d5-46ef-8f1e-0e6f1e2a1ff5", "value": "A stall where animals are kept individually."}

{"id": "6a3ffc77-f492-4046-a1bd-72678ad6ae8b", "value": "A place or building where animals can be washed. Often in the form of a pool with a walled funnel-like structure enabling animals to be guided into the pool."}
{"id": "f7e51dc1-d7e4-4d77-b4dc-91e7fe7d28f5", "value": "A village cemetery where cinerary urns were buried in large numbers during the Bronze Age."}
{"id": "55f58229-c5e7-4f15-8881-500deeb1ac75", "value": "A pathway, not necessarily designed as such, beaten down by the feet of travellers."}

{"id": "59ec9c5e-238e-4735-be30-8e1098cce6bf", "value": "A track of two parallel ruts deliberately cut in the ground or living rock for the guidance of two-wheeled carts when the way was obscured by darkness or water."}
