{"id": "f4c97094-ef03-479c-9d98-2101a28a0fc9", "value": "A shed in which delicate plants are reared from seedlings for planting out later."}

{"id": "e3da0226-511c-4823-ad8f-12f58fbb048f", "value": "The name of a class of excavations, found in chalk formations in England, consisting of a shaft sunk to the chalk, and there widening out into one or more chambers."}
{"id": "ad23f791-bfa5-4904-8d26-b7a1d49e3c8e", "value": "A place from which chalk is extracted."}

{"id": "d3c2a81f-ca90-45e2-99a4-ec1aa13f0c1a", "value": "An institution for the imprisonment of prisoners who can be trusted to serve their sentence without likelihood of escape and of being a threat to the public. There is no physical barrier designed to prevent absconding."}
{"id": "c32aca3b-0276-4808-8ba3-e20770b0e1a3", "value": "An underground foot tunnel primarily constructed to allow for the passage of pedestrians beneath an over ground obstacle."}
{"id": "87377be5-0101-4940-907e-28cf61d83dc0", "value": "A section of road that provides a passage beneath another road or railway."}
{"id": "14569bac-8809-4dd8-bed8-55b87d5a3ce8", "value": "An underground passageway for cables, pipes and pedestrians to allow passage beneath an over ground obstacle."}
{"id": "28dfb473-4d32-4d92-bc21-b363d790c027", "value": "A fighter satellite station watch office built to Air Ministry design drawing number 14383/40."}
{"id": "e8aa5c33-d4aa-48cf-959c-5d6cf8b124ad", "value": "A chair fixed to the end of a plank, in which scolds or dishonest people were tied and ducked in water as a punishment."}
{"id": "f1821ca2-b1fa-4ae2-8ca1-cad6c3f32bb8", "value": "A castle without a motte."}
{"id": "c91cf26c-bb05-4e67-a07b-87a20ea6ba61", "value": "A defence work, either a detached fieldwork or an outwork built as part of a fortification as a last defensive position."}
{"id": "8662bd17-ed2c-48f1-a522-b1e41b85916f", "value": "Earthworks and buildings added around a bastion to enhance protection of the bastion."}

{"id": "9df7f3f0-dae7-43e0-a056-815998ef51a0", "value": "In fortification, a detached triangular outwork consisting of two battered faces forming a salient angle. Usually positioned in the ditch in front of a rampart and between two bastions. Term mainly for military architecture from 15th century and later."}
{"id": "6cfa8301-11b0-47b3-aac5-40a2d7f4a53a", "value": "An area where birds are protected and bred."}
{"id": "380dec5f-f833-4c74-894b-5fed946a8ac9", "value": "A house or range of buildings where domestic dogs and cats can be kept for a period."}
{"id": "d064f47c-d540-4254-a051-3bebf6050491", "value": "A range of buildings used to house abandoned or stray dogs."}
{"id": "843d2c3e-0db9-49d2-a97f-01276e07a75e", "value": "A building, range of buildings or site, for the accommodation, rearing and/or treatment of animals, birds and fish, both wild and domestic."}
{"id": "1fac41b6-2e43-4c0c-9a10-299a996accdf", "value": "A place where injured or endangered animals are kept and looked after."}

{"id": "914c31f5-5722-4580-9d09-87ae5a6e53b8", "value": "A building or group of buildings designed for the breeding and rearing of animals, including fish and birds. Often include incubators and heated rooms."}
{"id": "eb3d401a-0259-42f5-9832-5943e2b30fd3", "value": "A site used for the production of anaesthetic gas."}
{"id": "9cae347a-bdc6-4133-bac6-1f2ad44a4bb2", "value": "Buildings and plant used for the refining of oil or the production of chemicals using oil."}
{"id": "b4d48dd9-d0f7-4aa9-97a0-ea97a993bab0", "value": "A graduated post or pole adjacent to an area at risk of flooding to indicate the depth of water during a flood."}

{"id": "d03afd4e-36c0-4dae-baf4-3a115502969b", "value": "An engine in which a vertical piston rod supplies energy via a crankshaft directly to the flywheel suspended above the cylinder. Extensively used as mine winding engines."}
{"id": "86dd4736-c602-49c1-80e6-0e672e56e2e9", "value": "An engine used for directly winding up coal from deep mines, first used in the 18th century."}
{"id": "bcffba05-d8bc-44a5-84a3-608a381190e6", "value": "A winch powered by a small steam engine used to drag barges, boats and other vehicles up an inclined plane."}
{"id": "aa11bc71-0931-4a4f-bcf4-05eea3e1ec13", "value": "A place where letters and parcels are sorted before being distributed. Usually found at a large general post office."}
{"id": "b5cafa94-7ee3-470b-a51d-2fc4174fd8ad", "value": "A building, department or shop where postal business is carried on."}

{"id": "23684564-5e69-4b9e-a893-b04840d27281", "value": "A garden building, usually in the Gothic or classical style. The term can be applied to many types of garden building with an interior space in which to stand or sit. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "87d9faec-3c02-473e-b71c-61abf730410e", "value": "An 18th century garden building, designed in the style of a classical Ionic temple, used for standing or sitting in."}
{"id": "06df4e63-a506-405f-b2d7-ac86f874492e", "value": "Use for places of worship. For later landscape features use, eg. GARDEN TEMPLE."}
{"id": "7e729d8d-ab95-4ece-a4a2-fb49388ae3b7", "value": "An 18th century garden building, designed in the form of a classical Doric temple, used for standing or sitting in."}
{"id": "5db21f45-c455-46d4-b39d-e3ca98b15a18", "value": "A garden building, octagonal in plan, designed in the style of a classical temple, used for standing or sitting in."}
{"id": "c0c3dc3a-d6b8-4e77-b4e8-888736ff02ba", "value": "An isolated building, circular in plan, generally consisting of one apartment with a domed roof, eg. Mausoleum at Castle Howard, Yorkshire."}
{"id": "11e116f1-5c5a-4fcd-b0ba-1230324267cb", "value": "A building or other establishment used for the retail, making and repairing of jewellery."}
{"id": "e2f45a00-0e5f-4521-bef1-f7347ce26f49", "value": "A workshop used for the manufacture of items of jewellery and/or timepieces from precious metals and precious or semi-precious stones."}
{"id": "75281bbf-717b-4c78-83ee-102e7f44acb6", "value": "A site where artefacts are manufactured from jet."}
{"id": "434ee9ce-93a5-4e19-90ea-639038744969", "value": "A site used for the production and/or working of glass."}
{"id": "7b0952cf-6517-4d92-aa63-0b56d2e1db49", "value": "A site associated with the large scale construction of buildings or items manufactured by the building industry."}
{"id": "f505bea3-f125-4a98-949a-7790452367a6", "value": "An industrial manufacturing complex producing bricks."}
{"id": "6615b3c7-37c0-4cde-8fab-d2858d97450a", "value": "A building or room used for small scale manufacture. Use more specific term where possible."}
{"id": "b0fee3db-acdf-4463-8292-cc9b6b4c6e0f", "value": "Works producing a refractory clay, kaolin. An essential raw material of porcelain and some types of papermaking."}
{"id": "81d704a3-dac3-471d-bea2-0b58c53c0536", "value": "An industrial complex concerned with the manufacture of gas for domestic use from coal and oil."}

{"id": "09371cd2-fbf0-402e-a976-bf1d9a50f15a", "value": "An area of land owned by a developer, whether a private entrepreneur or a public authority, and divided into plots for leasing or sale to manufacturing or commercial concerns which may share some common services."}
{"id": "1c24b8f5-f2b9-435a-97e4-4c006a617173", "value": "A site where concrete and concrete products are manufactured from a mixture of cement and aggregate."}
{"id": "07152a11-6a6c-450b-afc3-938d1e1ed22e", "value": "A site where clay pipes used for drainage are manufactured."}
{"id": "940e8fcd-96d5-4825-bf00-435e111755c5", "value": "A factory for the assembly of components. Usually associated with the manufacture of vehicles: cars, lorries, etc."}
{"id": "1a667a68-ae51-4e95-88b7-4c93956e817c", "value": "A building or site used in the production of enamelled goods."}
{"id": "761eeb10-45fb-4f98-9d98-c26a9b4439fd", "value": "A large scale works for cloth finishing processes."}
{"id": "73c4a5e0-0f71-41ed-9290-3de02c1e91d6", "value": "A factory making baize for snooker and gaming tables."}
{"id": "d0036c2d-c70d-4d42-8793-eb673e523f51", "value": "A place where telephones and their components are manufactured"}
{"id": "e41676d4-538b-45b3-8954-5cce21e43232", "value": "Any factory or site using machine tools in a manufacturing or processing capacity."}

{"id": "c2268695-0348-4805-8392-9020fe70b2ac", "value": "An area or defined space believed to have been used for trades and/or manufacturing activity. Only use when evidence for more specific site type is lacking."}

{"id": "ef6ae348-e21c-49c7-9504-c712f856922a", "value": "A building or site used in the production of japanned goods. Japanning was the process of covering a material with a hard, black lacquer in imitation of Japanese lacquer work."}
{"id": "28987b20-b967-4d8e-806a-5e0c8b036e33", "value": "A site incorporating all of the production processes for the manufacture of plaster."}
{"id": "daf98686-c001-4c45-91f6-91c99ecd2ca5", "value": "A building or site used for the manufacture of whiting either from crushed chalk, limestone, marble or through chemical preparation."}
{"id": "918628ae-2aae-440a-a1da-18c167635a8e", "value": "Usually a complex of buildings for the processing of raw materials. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "af2538bb-d35b-4b31-9aa8-5b3b0b4e4852", "value": "An engineering works that produces machinery specially for use in shoe making."}
{"id": "eced506c-2cff-4f72-af30-4e39ea14b1fc", "value": "A complex of buildings where barytes is processed for industrial use."}
{"id": "62faebde-bd49-4665-85b6-75b97afe7877", "value": "A site used for all the processes associated with the manufacture of roof, floor or decorative tiles."}
{"id": "3873c6aa-18dd-4065-bee1-14e72fd68474", "value": "A works, including an extractive site, producing a clay of high plasticity and firmness, used as a basic raw material for porcelain."}
{"id": "cb4dee5d-e168-4832-976b-b6191ad9f92d", "value": "Recovery and removal of grease (lanolin) from raw wool."}
{"id": "1743d961-fe23-48ff-9cf6-aa2f2062a663", "value": "A building or site used for the production of bricks and other items, from a clay with refractory properties."}
{"id": "13f2aaed-e9f6-4f3b-880a-b9231efea053", "value": "Floor cover in Roman time, where small cubes (tesserea) of one or more colours were laid in a geometric pattern."}
{"id": "2225d04f-b1db-4fe4-9f2b-b75b45130247", "value": "A searchlight battery, which points out to sea, used to locate enemy shipping"}
{"id": "8bfb03df-fe38-48fd-a889-84ad5b59a19c", "value": "A searchlight battery used to light a beach."}

{"id": "5738529c-e2f2-4232-8a7f-57331c954741", "value": "A flour mill which uses one or more pairs of horizontal millstones to grind wheat into flour which millers call a \u00ef\u00bf\u00bdsudden death\u00ef\u00bf\u00bd process; within not more than 90 seconds complete wheat grain becomes wholemeal flour."}
{"id": "4206984c-4674-4a9b-a7e1-75ec122b9f50", "value": "A crude shelter for persons engaged in the production of pure carbon by the controlled burning of wood and other organic materials."}
{"id": "561f1c7e-d506-4a1d-9d1d-c658e481d472", "value": "A small building used as a shelter by a shepherd."}
{"id": "f4d1a859-543a-4a3f-9884-998a443b84de", "value": "Levelled or terraced area of ground presumed to have been the site of a house or hut."}

{"id": "ff31e26f-981f-4c97-930e-9e4f22fddec3", "value": "A building of basic construction, usually smaller in size than a house and constructed from a variety of materials such as mud, turf, branches, wood, brick, concrete or metal. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "7a69bf17-d0c2-41a3-b66b-f99e5b05f4db", "value": "A rough shelter or dwelling, sometimes used to house cattle."}
{"id": "9e8268c0-72e5-4dd1-bf3b-e51a35f91efa", "value": "A hut provided as accommodation for hop pickers and may also be know as a Hop Pickers' Hut"}

{"id": "1a91f28c-2617-4966-a8cb-3159c560b664", "value": "A round house indicated by the presence of a low, roughly circular bank of turf, earth or stone, which formed the base of the walls. Characteristic of the later prehistoric period. Where several occur together use HUT CIRCLE SETTLEMENT."}
{"id": "76935bd1-999d-4e07-ae98-dadcea6b8af3", "value": "A hilltop enclosure bounded by one or more substantial banks, ramparts and ditches. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "424fe3f8-6254-474a-beeb-57f1f36ba647", "value": "A site with one or more defensive earthworks, often at a river crossing incorporating natural features which define parts of the curtilage."}
{"id": "a406768a-e531-439b-9140-cba875aff829", "value": "An imprecise term used to describe large Iron Age settlements of town-like proportions."}
{"id": "d2aa0b1f-9d0b-4f57-ba3a-d82c00e24000", "value": "A detached fort covering a strategic point."}

{"id": "c0756daa-2285-432c-a817-37f74ec876e0", "value": "Unspecified defensive structure like a mound of earth, a rampart, an embankment or a wall-like fortification. Also used as an early term for a bastion or blockhouse. Use more specific term where known."}

{"id": "f059bc64-e5d3-4ad5-b95c-307354a1e0d0", "value": "A fortified tower designed to house a number of artillery pieces and a small garrison. Artillery towers first appear in England in the 16th century."}
{"id": "4a93a322-b539-4aa6-b3ab-04fa0c542e37", "value": "A structure, often built undergound, used for defence and co-ordination of military activity."}
{"id": "dc962d69-97cb-44ca-8258-2126e6e02969", "value": "A vault used for the storage of cider."}

{"id": "6ed17ce3-3cfc-4402-aa06-d1127bbbfa40", "value": "A building, or part of a building, for the milling and pressing of cider apples to produce cider (or pears for perry) and for storing the drink in barrels."}
{"id": "1f995b28-9531-4bd7-9e4e-ee51fefd3f42", "value": "A room or group of rooms usually below the ground level and usually under a building, often used for storing fuel, provisions or wines."}
{"id": "ba647bd2-69a6-40ef-accb-32cf7c689066", "value": "A press used to extract the juice from apples, which was then used to make cider."}
{"id": "99daa9fe-ba3c-44a8-b81c-53947091ac7d", "value": "A building designed to house a lifeboat, usually with a stone ramp to launch the boat into the sea."}
{"id": "34676bc2-9e71-4cb9-b980-c4a7815794ce", "value": "A building specifically built to house life saving apparatus used when conditions prevented the lifeboat from deploying."}
{"id": "97f0afa9-f93c-4d0d-9d15-f997147896b6", "value": "A building or group of buildings situated close to the sea used by coastguards to enable them to monitor the coastline."}

{"id": "4b20c12a-dcf8-47f7-9066-3149069ecfef", "value": "A protected parachute store built with permanent brick cavity walls and a roof of reinforced concrete slabs in two heights separated by lantern lights."}
{"id": "d539a05c-e4d7-4349-a665-7c1db66a105d", "value": "Distinctive clerestory-roofed building, used for the drying and storage of military parachutes."}

{"id": "202fa923-fb92-4ee7-85b0-7b12010e0888", "value": "A brick-built building with four windows on the north-facing wall with a pitched roof and with a dormer roof light on both sides, intended for drying, storing and packing parachutes.The 2355/25 was the first design for a purpose-built parachute store."}

{"id": "4a758fb5-e3db-4d7b-bb79-79454aaf8afe", "value": "A distinctive, clerestory-roofed building of three 10ft and two 12ft bays, used for the drying, storage and packing of military parachutes and built to Air Ministry drawing number 10825/42."}

{"id": "519e77db-a767-4c39-b8f5-0ef1095018f5", "value": "A hut 51ft long by 20ft wide used to dry, store and pack parachutes.Similar in design to the 2355/25, but constructed in timber instead of brick."}
{"id": "6e946159-0054-44ad-abed-56456539550f", "value": "A protected parachute store similar in design to the 6351/37 except constructed wholly from reinforced concrete."}

{"id": "021635e2-e9d9-4f63-9824-99c9f4d7f2a0", "value": "A distinctive, clerestory-roofed building of five 10ft bays, used for the drying, storage and packing of military parachutes and built to Air Ministry drawing number 11137/41."}

{"id": "15253ef4-c112-4dac-b495-002705b4650d", "value": "A distinctive, clerestory-roofed building of five 10ft bays, used for the drying, storage and packing of military parachutes and built to Air Ministry drawing number 17865/39."}

{"id": "9f88bf8c-c6ce-45e1-9973-e9a5d2e0a399", "value": "A building within a complex, such as a leisure centre, school, industrial site etc, often containing toilet and washing facilities, where individuals can change their clothes. For a changing room within a larger building, see Components."}
{"id": "c6496b11-81d6-4ab7-a5c1-0429197b6875", "value": "A shallow outdoor pool, usually rectangular in shape filled with water which when frozen was used for the sport of Curling."}
{"id": "1b2620d1-3f28-4f2e-8229-70f90d80994a", "value": "A large, deep, manmade pool, usually with accompanying diving boards/platforms and forming part of a swimming pool complex."}
{"id": "22495a7d-cce2-4b63-9edc-78291336e35a", "value": "A specially marked ground used by children for the game of hopscotch."}

{"id": "9c4af7fb-03d4-4499-bf26-547132cf6da8", "value": "A large, manmade pool, usually lined with tiles, rubber or similar. Can be placed in the open air, eg. a LIDO, or built as part of a covered sports centre."}
{"id": "6c5177a4-f78e-43c3-88ae-6b4088742d1f", "value": "A tower with one or more horizontal platforms extending out over deep water for use in diving competitions."}
{"id": "136d1d3a-361e-4548-b682-b1e03c9a0fa3", "value": "An area of ground in which horses can be exercised."}
{"id": "9d284bc5-237e-4b68-8d4b-fee6c7f04355", "value": "A school for instruction in the art of horsemanship."}
{"id": "d9b17c01-28a8-4591-8d15-b9bfb92ad25b", "value": "An area where the sport of wrestling takes place."}
{"id": "19c92692-56c2-410a-bc1a-ab9d9a3b1f9a", "value": "A building, site or structure associated with the playing of ball sports."}
{"id": "25865282-b0ce-42ef-af5c-cf1341d14972", "value": "A public ground with facilities for games and other activities."}
{"id": "f5308e41-ba55-4539-9d6d-04023992ab80", "value": "A building, site or structure associated with the playing of racket sports."}
{"id": "ade7d9e0-aa74-4821-aef8-4363ece59157", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with sporting activities."}

{"id": "39ce76bd-9e04-4418-9148-1851912f9462", "value": "A structure consisting of a large plastic pipe attached to a high tower and sloping down to a swimming pool. Water flows down the inside allowing people to slide down into the pool below."}

{"id": "8760132e-716d-492b-8274-396d95854e15", "value": "An open flat gound where the sport of shooting with bow and arrows is pursued. The ground can be equipped with targets mounted on butts and various fixed distance marker."}
{"id": "fdf44b3c-666c-4d86-8425-84d15a8126b1", "value": "Site or building used for paintballing."}

{"id": "2632d362-421e-48e1-b2cc-4d765ad376b1", "value": "A purpose-built facility providing an area for wheeled sports, such as skateboarding, skating and BMX cycling, equipped with ramps and other structures and obstacles for the performance of tricks and manoeuvres."}
{"id": "72f9447a-773c-4eb2-8aba-ed402bce1d4a", "value": "A building, site or structure associated with various racing sports."}
{"id": "0b95b7a1-f179-4115-8142-bf7076197758", "value": "A building in which a sport is played. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "c374d284-5b2c-42ea-9aa3-96de2f2b6c2a", "value": "A large, usually unroofed building with tiers of seats for spectators built in various shapes and enclosing a field used for sports events."}
{"id": "7863c749-53d1-40fc-9d5d-bdf8989a5855", "value": "A large board found at sporting events, erected so as to be seen by the spectators, on which the score of a game is kept."}

{"id": "b8473389-40b0-4967-bd9b-a5a684055cd9", "value": "An artificially constructed wall with recessed and projecting grips for hands and feet and places to attach ropes. Used for practising rock climbing. If the wall is situated within a sports centre use term from Components thesaurus."}
{"id": "9de69f3f-d2f9-4f2e-a751-4c08e48cd034", "value": "A building where horses are rubbed down after training."}
{"id": "4d34f351-09e4-4d80-a4a4-c8b5c75f1441", "value": "A public recreational complex centred around an open-air swimming pool. Use SWIMMING POOL as a component of LIDO."}
{"id": "112ad7f3-ff8e-4bc3-9ca0-05f48ae43379", "value": "A parcel of land."}
{"id": "0990b924-33fd-4e92-9303-128d0a70df38", "value": "Places of residence."}
{"id": "7dfa3729-0796-4791-a6b0-237dfdc73091", "value": "A cheap eating and drinking establishment usually serving snacks and non-alcoholic drinks."}
{"id": "701ad3f4-e4b0-4d93-8852-0116c1921366", "value": "A place where refreshments or meals may be obtained."}
{"id": "c302cbcb-4221-441c-89db-cb22e46e1aab", "value": "A small eating and drinking establishment or refreshment bar."}
{"id": "187ac403-13a8-4637-afeb-7a54d4f00c65", "value": "A self-service dining room, especially for workers/employees; also in institutions, such as schools, hospitals, etc."}
{"id": "b16b2b74-91a7-4e99-8fb2-12e02d9c101c", "value": "A channel dug, or built up, to carry away surplus water from a river or waterway to prevent it bursting its banks and flooding."}

{"id": "54363f31-78fe-48e9-a318-44e2abe0b2d4", "value": "Manmade constructions used to prevent water flooding the surrounding area. Often taking the form of a bank or wall but may be more elaborate e.g. the Thames Barrier."}
{"id": "4af95ec7-ccc4-4d65-96ce-a2234209db33", "value": "A large wooden structure built alongside the water's edge where ships may lie for unloading."}
{"id": "7d0a7683-2990-45ba-b181-9a90609e6e8e", "value": "A large, level structure, usually of stone or timber, built alongside water to allow warships to moor for the loading and unloading of guns."}

{"id": "b61d8105-f101-48d0-98b5-35832e79740b", "value": "An artificial paved bank or solid landing place built parallel to, or projecting out from, the shoreline to serve in the loading and unloading of vessels."}
{"id": "34fa5157-6331-443f-91db-fc653eef1974", "value": "A large wooden structure built alongside the edge of a river where boats may lie for the loading and unloading of goods and passengers."}
{"id": "031864ff-e2e6-482c-ad54-6ddbf3af9642", "value": "A large wooden structure built alongside the edge of a canal where narrow boats may lie for the loading and unloading of goods."}
{"id": "8301e735-8130-44e3-8107-fc8195db2584", "value": "A shop selling tea, butter, flour, sugar, spices, tinned foods and miscellaneous household stores."}
{"id": "bf874fbf-cc97-4b36-ad60-3111418cb718", "value": "A coal-burning power station where domestic electricity for an area is produced, eg. Battersea Power Station, London."}
{"id": "22764731-b081-4690-ad6a-37372ba4f5a0", "value": "A commercial bakery or bread factory. If domestic use BAKEHOUSE."}
{"id": "5c338c03-2afb-4b43-8774-045fe78eecc6", "value": "A service building to a country house, farm, etc, used for baking. If commercial premises use BAKERY."}
{"id": "de16dcc8-ef31-4981-abdd-e30b33042f09", "value": "A factory where flour was produced for use in food products."}

{"id": "16052379-039c-4ea9-838d-bf524b9abe9b", "value": "A workshop with a forge for the melting and working of white metal, ie. low-melting alloys. Also used for a smith specializing in decorative or finely finished wrought iron work."}
{"id": "98fa5ad1-83df-4588-8d74-975da862b534", "value": "A building or room used for any type of engineering work. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "6ba67be0-3f1b-4270-aac3-71da27333d3a", "value": "Area feature visible as an earthwork or cropmark with no known function."}

{"id": "d3fe0f2e-0b86-416e-bf56-fc314ae6fb12", "value": "Originally partially covered baths shaped somewhat like a slipper, now usually a number of single baths of the modern domestic style installed for hire at public baths."}
{"id": "d89e4a6f-b8c1-4cc5-95f8-fd4845771365", "value": "A treadwheel using a donkey as motive power. Usually found operating wells."}
{"id": "6f135da8-1cc1-42cc-8696-f0661578f310", "value": "A building with an aisle on one side only."}
{"id": "afc6cabb-aa2a-4d8a-9809-2be3fe94ae74", "value": "A building with an aisle along one or both sides. Usually a row of posts separates the main space from the aisle."}
{"id": "70ec6c9f-1e92-41df-9987-b9b0ec7bccfd", "value": "A house with an open hall whose main span is separated by an arcade from the side aisles."}

{"id": "9c9cf7d8-093c-43b8-a8cd-af8b43cbb33b", "value": "The residence or official premises of a consul, the official appointed by a state to protect its citizens and commercial interests in a foreign state."}
{"id": "c80d05ec-59d4-4597-833a-75b186fbd502", "value": "An open circular area where avenues converge."}
{"id": "1cc5bd26-fa52-4855-b074-5ddcc77c80dd", "value": "A tree-lined way or approach where the trees have been cut into various forms and shapes."}

{"id": "13264ec4-cb61-48a2-8bf7-3a5d2de82d44", "value": "Medieval Fenland ditched field system where the land is divided into strips for agricultural production. The strips are separated by hand-dug wide shallow drainage ditches with the spoil thrown up to create a dryer ridge."}
{"id": "d38bea43-0f0b-4ba1-bdc7-cff4f28f7b9d", "value": "A building to house waterwheels, attached to a WATERMILL or water-powered factory."}
{"id": "771be71c-2e33-4ac0-83af-59bd9f84ddb3", "value": "An apparatus for burning refuse to ashes."}
{"id": "5dac874e-dd8e-4bf0-bbcf-d07c96533b95", "value": "Power station using domestic refuse as its principal fuel."}
{"id": "d8aa1e2d-d858-4eab-88d5-41cbe3d0e518", "value": "A place where domestic refuse is collected for disposal."}

{"id": "17ff203b-e313-4584-8c5b-907f3c694175", "value": "For the disposal of town refuse. Some 19th century plants were linked to a power station. Later ones incorporate INCINERATORS, recycling facilities, etc."}
{"id": "7e53f723-cf25-4291-8347-be9f1c34d511", "value": "Area of land set aside and managed for the preservation of flora, fauna, their natural habitats and physical features."}
{"id": "032e4f36-019d-42b7-b584-a3493b3d6ce8", "value": "Garden area next to public house used for the comsumption of alcoholic beverages."}
{"id": "c8c04b83-5240-460f-905a-03ad6c3e58e5", "value": "A natural or man-made gap in vegetation or other combustible material that acts as a barrier to slow or stop the progress of a fire."}

{"id": "d3de9d3e-a4ca-4c1b-801c-06d03d7a1585", "value": "A bowl-shaped cavity or depression created in the subsoil by the long term presence and growth of tree roots or when a large tree is blown over or has its stump pulled out."}
{"id": "be183dfc-07b0-4b45-951a-d0d026d71b6c", "value": "Pipes used to carry water or hydraulic fluid for power transmission within a hydraulic system."}
{"id": "ff0a8208-79da-44b7-924e-5a3f54d44208", "value": "A steep bank or slope. In fortifications, the bank or wall immediately in front of and below the rampart."}
{"id": "d388d69c-5273-43fe-b9cd-17f150ea15d7", "value": "Circular enclosure featuring an enclosing bank with no accompanying ditch. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "c0c83c0b-d222-49ea-b915-9c198900038a", "value": "Linear or curvilinear construction of earth, turf and stone, often, but not always accompanied by a ditch. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "91f59472-25d5-4595-9d0a-32a49e8b6090", "value": "A house for the keeper of a level crossing on a railway."}
{"id": "0f7efaa7-ce9f-42d0-90b2-4a159162c02c", "value": "Purpose-built housing for railway workers."}

{"id": "d9a6d00b-e46a-43f4-995f-cec95619396b", "value": "A prefrabicated home sited in parks where a pitch fee is charged. Although technically mobile they usually only make one journey before being permanently installed."}
{"id": "05066fe2-1f1b-4b59-8d6f-ffcd5a2de9c7", "value": "The limit line of a field."}

{"id": "f47232f4-7b6a-44af-808d-80af974c919f", "value": "A terraced field usually found on hillsides. Comprising a flat strip of land, called the tread, and a steep, scarped lynchet or edge, called the riser."}

{"id": "73482a28-1d15-4c76-b1a9-49ca9aa81097", "value": "A bank formed at the end of a field by soil which, loosened by the plough, gradually moves down slope through a combination of gravity and erosion."}
{"id": "37610114-74dc-4f50-ad5b-919c2362a414", "value": "An enclosure for pigs that includes a covered pen and yard."}
{"id": "13304624-09ae-4bf0-9b4e-b2bdd66e0c14", "value": "A place where pigs are reared."}
{"id": "9ad548cb-94b7-4190-be1f-8cbf04d2a570", "value": "A building combining a pigsty at ground level with a poultry house in a loft over."}
{"id": "4a7681d5-90ff-40fb-98af-acbf101b794b", "value": "A structure providing accommodation for poultry."}

{"id": "1c31e71f-1d02-4d92-b3d7-ee56aea7d952", "value": "A building or room within a granary used to dry grain. Often consisting of an oven with a refractory-brick drying floor above, on which the grain was placed."}
{"id": "c63b9676-610f-4f77-b15c-ee1e4d93708e", "value": "A modern fodder store on a farm."}
{"id": "8eb519c9-97ae-405d-8aeb-60230f9da2ca", "value": "An area within a building used for the storage of cheese."}
{"id": "5a0f4923-a2cc-4550-828c-664dd29f5a86", "value": "A mill which contains machinery for separating grain from the chaff."}
{"id": "2b72792f-c5cf-4f82-b0b6-469580bc9f32", "value": "A separate compartment for livestock in which they are free to move about."}
{"id": "54d7afbf-7ab7-45c4-94c7-067685acc98a", "value": "A tower used to store grain in."}
{"id": "b4798611-d06f-4af5-8ecf-5cbfa2816e1b", "value": "A room or building used for the storage of fleeces."}
{"id": "587702a8-906d-4591-9e35-f272634ba83d", "value": "A building or structure of unknown function found on a farm. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "9f881d5b-0d0d-4139-a362-7203d943dbbb", "value": "A building in which animals are housed. For non agricultural use see ANIMAL HOUSE and narrow terms in RECREATIONAL class."}

{"id": "1208c722-060b-406a-804d-2d5eb931950e", "value": "An area within a building (usually the barn or stable) for storing husks from the grain crop (chaff) for animal feed after it has been threshed and winnowed in the barn."}
{"id": "d202a207-585c-484a-997f-52690ccffcb9", "value": "A multi-purpose farm building."}
{"id": "bc4a0708-8fe7-4341-bd74-2f847dbcbc46", "value": "A building used in the preparation of manure."}
{"id": "2d8342ba-14b8-4e81-bb74-5cb76fb4fc2b", "value": "A building used to prepare and store dry food such as hay and straw for the feeding of cattle."}
{"id": "bf1f2ded-7845-4295-b44d-9846ea8c44e6", "value": "A building, or part of a building for the boiling and preparation of animal feed, usually attached to pigsties."}
{"id": "7c280222-7c38-4ad8-b5de-fd4d22239235", "value": "A building in which potatoes can sprout and germinate."}
{"id": "e241018e-e954-40d0-a429-bc0e08e1944c", "value": "A factory where fruit and seed oil is produced by an oil machine."}

{"id": "58367f1f-c83c-40d4-9eb5-03ed808a8735", "value": "A multipurpose hut constructed from stone and turf, covering a square or polygonal plan. It has drystone walls and a slightly corbelled roof, usually topped with slabs. Can be either free-standing or embedded in a Cornish hedge. Particular to Cornwall."}
{"id": "f035395a-3091-4c3c-af9a-28ddd75c44f1", "value": "Engineering works specializing in the production and maintenance of non-passenger carrying railway rolling stock."}

{"id": "a6620877-c603-4d7e-b0c2-cf5a55ab0bb4", "value": "A prepared slope with rails on which boats can be transferred from one canal to another at a higher or lower level. The boats can either be floated in a caisson or carried in a cradle or sling."}
{"id": "499660a8-48f6-49d9-9b1f-1512fe66298c", "value": "An external structure used to sit on."}
{"id": "33da92ac-59b6-4685-906d-fd9133612c8c", "value": "A type of GARDEN HOUSE, usually in the form of an open-fronted shelter with seat."}
{"id": "a5925851-c907-4fbf-97fb-ec76d77e6fc7", "value": "A lattice work bower or shady retreat covered with climbing plants."}
{"id": "d929e041-4f0d-4e6f-8df4-dce35ec8f14b", "value": "A garden seat covered in clipped, camomile plants which release a fragrant smell when sat upon."}
{"id": "9ae107e3-1a57-4846-99ce-06a527819246", "value": "A garden house situated to provide a commanding view."}
{"id": "e61883a4-7b23-4a5d-affb-abdcfc7a2eb7", "value": "Seats or benches covered in turf, built against a wall, tree or fountain, were a common feature of medieval enclosed gardens."}
{"id": "3bac463e-731a-4a26-94b2-551142f7dc86", "value": "A textile-weaving factory housing powerlooms; commonly a one-storeyed shed with wide, north-light roof carried on iron columns."}

{"id": "d1b426fa-dfa4-4df0-9a13-ff02801e41d0", "value": "A factory where worsted, a well-twisted woollen yarn made from long staple wool and used in the manufacture of suits and other garments, was produced."}

{"id": "45bef902-2bfa-4bb7-9616-af43710824d0", "value": "A factory, incorporating power driven machinery from the late 18th century, where cloth was manufactured from threads interlaced at right angles to each other in a loom."}
{"id": "6358d3e0-baa9-4bff-ad3c-fcea12bc9d4a", "value": "A factory where tweed, a twilled woollen fabric with an unfinished surface, is manufactured."}
{"id": "199a00db-009f-4d86-987d-7ede37522010", "value": "A factory where lengths of soft, woollen cloth, loosely woven to retain heat, used as a bed covering, were manufactured."}
{"id": "495b2c37-1dbf-4440-86d8-59ac98eff02b", "value": "A former ground surface buried beneath an earthwork or other sequence of deposits. (includes palaeosoils, turf lines)"}

skos:Concept.skos:altLabel: {"id": "d92e1ea7-dd3e-42c6-97d5-5fa075874fb1", "value": "City Of London Coal Duties Boundary Marker"}
skos:Concept.skos:scopeNote: {"id": "0692879f-77e1-4f62-b723-60d0cdbab7af", "value": "A cast-iron or stone boundary post, obelisk or plate found on roads, railways, canals etc around London marking the boundary within which a duty was payable on coal."}
{"id": "e6583ceb-8186-4897-8878-3cc03741341b", "value": "A marker stone showing the extent of a measure of land containing a vein of ore."}
{"id": "d360895d-ad3b-4921-802d-8f3167c2b0f0", "value": "A stone that indicates the limit of an area or piece of land."}
{"id": "be640cf2-3faf-4b4a-b57c-540526acb027", "value": "Use only where stone is natural or where there is no indication of function."}
{"id": "b68867db-7512-4e24-a26c-d77db31cc16e", "value": "A marker stone used to demarcate the boundaries of peat cutting grounds and indicate who held the rights for each particular parcel of land."}
{"id": "86240eef-0bf6-4831-9b48-515863f0fdc1", "value": "A pit for the extraction of fullers earth (a hydrous silicate of alumina), which was used for cleansing, and finishing, cloth and wool."}
{"id": "46125e9a-9a1a-4bd7-a881-1372b7a7887b", "value": "A works used for the production of copperas, a green iron sulphate which is used as a fixative in the dyeing process."}
{"id": "ad4b47a2-a59a-4534-8e1a-2a57bb89e81f", "value": "A clamp in which alum shale was burnt in the initial stage of processing."}
{"id": "bb033f8f-5a59-42cd-b4ad-f8b68f3375fe", "value": "A site where iron oxide and iron sulphates, used as brown pigments, are excavated."}
{"id": "e3df6ac8-c694-46f5-bef2-801c254b31c3", "value": "A factory in which is ink is prepared from pigments and additives."}
{"id": "645bd0ab-ebee-4eb1-ad0c-f4290da2c04b", "value": "A building or buildings used for the production of paints, varnishes, colours and distemper."}
{"id": "5e40e38f-4b49-4208-9fe4-621bafdc3986", "value": "A mill for grinding ochre for the paint making process."}
{"id": "f3f6c6bb-6776-4340-90e7-85bed02a05f4", "value": "A pit from which marl, a mixture of clay and carbonate of lime, is excavated. Marl is used as a fertilizer."}
{"id": "0cb5bd86-164c-4454-acfa-72535d1db92a", "value": "Buildings and sites used for the production of inorganic and organic dyes, pigments and paints."}
{"id": "069f04a4-3be6-46ee-a395-ce4c856dc51d", "value": "A pumping station used in the production of hydraulic power, eg. in warehouse complexes, goods depots on railways, etc."}
{"id": "a1fc4631-d595-49ed-8413-eb174d453c68", "value": "A tunnel running under a river or a hillside through which a railway line runs."}
{"id": "5b8a7173-48c9-476e-93c0-596f5c4ecd80", "value": "A tunnel through which a tramway runs."}
{"id": "566b82ce-4eb3-46a0-a0ed-ff1f0e4e0171", "value": "An often stately or ornate entrance to a railway tunnel."}
{"id": "96587ff7-e26b-4653-a0c2-954efd73c048", "value": "A shaft designed to allow for the adequate circulation of air through a transport tunnel, for example."}
{"id": "9d7b4007-20ae-4c01-9f70-df1f4f16dff4", "value": "A tunnel carrying a railway beneath the surface of the ground."}
{"id": "d0b8f455-b547-4742-925b-4a904c29396b", "value": "A room where a class of pupils is taught."}
{"id": "4756065d-90c0-4726-9882-531bdb309902", "value": "A point where water issues naturally from the rock or soil onto the ground or into a body of surface water."}
{"id": "79f114fd-20f4-4930-8773-b60d4c2292e6", "value": "A water point with a device to regulate the flow of water."}
{"id": "6db362de-63a5-4b27-9455-4ff5fc0a9bb2", "value": "A reservoir or tank used to hold a supply of water for fire-fighting purposes in the event of the main supply being damaged or cut off."}
{"id": "a04a4740-ddee-4a4f-ae7b-cf79250c2ca1", "value": "A machine used to raise and move water and other liquids, compress gases, etc. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "cc679823-288a-4104-82a6-fa58e671b7bf", "value": "A fountain erected specifically to supply drinking water."}
{"id": "152edac7-a0a5-422d-be9c-be750a0adf31", "value": "Site and structures associated with the supply of clean water."}

{"id": "6459dff4-030a-4771-ac26-90c129376aa9", "value": "An artificial aperture from which water springs. The water supply usually came from a lake or reservoir higher up in order to ensure the necessary flow and pressure. More recently fountains have been powered by pumps."}
{"id": "c0ffd935-184c-4ead-8e8f-2a13b70f6e56", "value": "A mill with machinery used to cut slabs of metal into rods, or thin sections, for use in nail making or wire drawing."}
{"id": "ed33f231-eb6e-454f-84ba-1e50699048ea", "value": "A mill in which sets of rollers were used to roll metal to set thicknesses or shapes such as rails, beams or rods."}
{"id": "9d08ed24-c972-4383-bb10-9dd96477823a", "value": "A factory where metal wire is manufactured."}
{"id": "5967f19f-863e-476d-a45c-34a928810656", "value": "A room specifically used for the display of furniture and other related materials"}
{"id": "2f68ee07-8728-41f7-a962-12b138091215", "value": "An iron frame placed over a coffin or at the entrance to a grave to act as a deterrent against resurrectionists."}
{"id": "2df1e25d-7042-4978-936f-630ef5c76faa", "value": "A place of worship at the site of a mortuary."}
{"id": "9583f1c1-7464-4a8d-b8ab-e1570f49f454", "value": "A place of worship within the grounds of a cemetery."}
{"id": "05871b1a-ca81-49ea-8615-8881b0ec0120", "value": "An area of ground, set apart for the burial of the dead."}
{"id": "f6e772c3-070b-47b5-9615-6b8f76b7b789", "value": "Steam engine, usually, driving a centrifugal fan to provide an air blast for a blast furnace."}
{"id": "a42a20ee-82f7-45b7-815b-dfc64f6163f1", "value": "A building used to accommodate ducks."}
{"id": "53baf682-2620-40ec-a7fa-e0943dd69492", "value": "A place used for the milking of cows."}
{"id": "c33f2afe-b79e-40d1-a52a-6aeeff4697ba", "value": "A building or group of buildings used for the making, processing, storing and selling of milk and other dairy products."}
{"id": "0f9d4982-ce02-4c79-9dfb-f99bcdb52f2e", "value": "A building or room for the storage of vegetables, particularly root vegetables, for human consumption."}
{"id": "c5200ddb-3bde-466b-a822-2c85bce5c72e", "value": "A building used for the storage of picked fruit."}
{"id": "fa46da4f-c4b1-4a45-abb7-7e1528bc76d5", "value": "A building in which cows are milked."}

{"id": "3d74f772-737a-49d2-9cd4-29b73633e66f", "value": "An outbuilding containing brewing equipment, as opposed to a large commercial BREWERY. Often found in conjunction with public houses, country houses etc."}
{"id": "fad02b4a-9ba1-4f98-a36c-aea4b1422e26", "value": "A room or building used for curing fish or meat."}
{"id": "87afe474-d0b0-41b5-b203-8bb9d0ef6fcf", "value": "A room used primarily for storing food and drink."}

{"id": "bb06f1b0-4337-4013-bcc1-a9f1658d262b", "value": "A building where fish are stored. Often taking the form of a single storey building with one room, but also may provide living accommodation for a fisherman above. Found mainly in the South West of England."}

{"id": "beb1fc24-c30e-49a2-87c7-ee43f2c6cca6", "value": "Device for extracting juice from apples, usually crab apples, for use in cooking and medicine. Consists of a stone base carved with channels in the upper surface which was used with an upper weight, often secured with a wooden beam wedged into position."}
{"id": "6532a5e9-9b43-49dc-bf84-dbb08357761e", "value": "A building used for the storage of fish."}
{"id": "f11844bc-1b98-4ded-bee8-8e9b0968a50e", "value": "A place where hops are stored."}
{"id": "929efee2-15b4-407d-acb5-efb31d386bdb", "value": "A HORSE GIN used for domestic cider manufacture, especially on farms."}
{"id": "b629a714-a385-4a50-8a9f-864e579dc2b7", "value": "A place where fish are processed after being caught."}
{"id": "46f96d18-0ae1-4941-ad5b-006d7f1b4fbf", "value": "A building or subterranean structure used for the storage of meat."}
{"id": "a3b3d7d9-0a04-4453-a9b7-990cd8d1b195", "value": "A building for the storage and drying of hops, often including a hop drying kiln. Usually built as part of a farm."}
{"id": "7b63531c-49bf-4761-a61b-20169353f59a", "value": "Terms included here are for small scale agricultural production. See also FOOD AND DRINK INDUSTRY SITE grouping in INDUSTRIAL class."}
{"id": "314ebff6-0261-40ed-acfd-4c85f18fafd2", "value": "A site where peat (vegetable matter decomposed in water and partly carbonised), used for fuel, is cut."}
{"id": "a403bda8-cb67-468e-be2e-b9b900a742a1", "value": "A fuel store for the storage of dried peat."}
{"id": "76586335-55db-43c9-9b26-9977944644fe", "value": "A structure used to dry peat on."}
{"id": "8170e1af-6c28-4193-a6d7-3f86429ec165", "value": "A house or shelter for the storage and/or launching of boats."}
{"id": "6fc4aba7-126a-4e4b-8691-11f60bd92c59", "value": "A dock or basin, often inland, used for mooring yachts and other small pleasure craft."}

{"id": "2b43d0e5-4349-46ad-9894-7fe147d7ae5c", "value": "A poorly understood Neolithic monument comprising a very long, narrow earthen mound. They may be of single-phase construction, or represent the addition of a linear extension to the bank of an existing Long Barrow."}
{"id": "2ae930c1-a40b-4206-9410-3356a6ed5bbb", "value": "A form of Neolithic long barrow comprising an oval, rather than rectangular or trapezoidal mound."}

{"id": "010ef3de-56cd-4dbb-9cdb-c17a95c67719", "value": "A rectangular or trapezoidal non-megalithic stony mound of Neolithic date, with human remains in cists rather than a large chamber. Mound construction and associated features vary considerably in type and complexity."}
{"id": "3105b930-e29d-4a4d-a17e-8fc2c07b7a2f", "value": "A long, narrow mound of earth or stone and of uncertain date and function. Use more appropriate term where possible."}
{"id": "59e6a469-f34f-45f9-bd0e-167b7b461355", "value": "A Neolithic burial monument comprising a stone-built chamber within a rectangular or trapezoidal earthen mound."}

{"id": "a0f36dd4-c823-416e-8c92-c9fe519f1704", "value": "A rectangular or trapezoidal earthen mound of Neolithic date, usually accompanied by flanking or encircling ditches, and normally associated with human remains. Mound construction and associated features vary considerably in type and complexity."}
{"id": "2fa71887-eb49-4681-ba26-5a2655067eab", "value": "A factory manufacturing insulation material for electrical cables."}
{"id": "a95ffc5c-6e38-44c8-bbc8-81fb6249be96", "value": "A wash room. Use with wider site type where known."}
{"id": "1c03d33f-3950-401c-8c16-425303a1aa08", "value": "A castle erected without permission, ie. without a royal licence to crenellate."}
{"id": "25e8a167-1758-489a-bf0e-13532b6b2d93", "value": "A low-temperature oven for the firing of metallic-based colour onto pottery after glazing."}

{"id": "f3f66078-cc88-4bbd-a2a5-d006595e8d18", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the production of pottery. Use only for sites where there is evidence of pottery manufacture but no specific monument, otherwise use more specific term."}
{"id": "f16e093c-963a-40b8-be97-c015a121e126", "value": "Regular courtyard farmsteads where the buildings are arranged around all four sides of the yard."}

{"id": "6220a03a-65f6-401a-b50b-473eb9e3319e", "value": "A two-storey watch office similar in design to drawing number 1959/34 but constructed completely from concrete. A large, almost square, ground plan with a central observation tower."}
{"id": "42250d0a-e705-4b04-978f-c532de896794", "value": "A fence that indicates the limit of an area or a piece of land."}
{"id": "1e9c820d-3fed-4175-84b7-35359d1741d1", "value": "A site where iron ore is extracted."}

The roundhouse is not attached to the mill itself. Some roundhouses were later converted for domestic purposes."}

{"id": "f0ba37aa-0383-45ad-af22-fa72d1709e96", "value": "Not a round barrow ploughed out at one end, but a specific type, the flat edge being additionally defined by stone slabs."}

{"id": "cf45b4ba-32f2-405a-9897-e271ba00f2f7", "value": "A piece of land, sometimes man-made, completely surrounded by water."}
{"id": "a0141883-a675-4f34-88d1-fb2c57fb1102", "value": "A road/carriage way giving access from the main road to the house, stables."}
{"id": "82155d5e-a0f0-4015-98b3-d8406cd7e07a", "value": "Unspecified landscape feature. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "84ec9101-8960-44e4-b8ac-cdbb055f4b26", "value": "A shelter in a public park."}
{"id": "e0c2e887-9014-4c70-a23d-aea33fc59c79", "value": "A house, enclosure or large cage for the keeping and breeding of birds."}

{"id": "057cd8db-2a4a-4934-a62c-179bbe5f564f", "value": "A circular bank in which trees have been planted for ornamental purposes or to create an enclosure. May exist purely as a bank which has been formed over the stumps of the trees which had been planted to form the enclosure."}
{"id": "0813ee82-b12c-4c4d-9664-04037a71b42a", "value": "An enclosed area of ground immediately surrounding a cathedral."}
{"id": "0bc5a78f-f17e-44d6-ad71-254d7c300334", "value": "A group of trees planted as part of a designed landscape."}
{"id": "d003e575-6274-4eda-97af-4b896c6a4891", "value": "A framework used as a support upon which fruit-trees or climbing plants are trained."}
{"id": "b31b9ee1-4870-452f-8f4d-911ba4cffe7d", "value": "A row of houses whose facade in plan follows the concave arc of a circle or ellipse, eg. The Royal Crescent, Bath."}
{"id": "4268a709-9785-4229-88ad-da0dca433ccb", "value": "A position or place that allows a wide or favourable overall view of a scene or situation."}

{"id": "a86675b9-5986-4c0b-8f49-b3d9dce36314", "value": "Planned &/or landscaped areas designed for aesthetic or recreational purposes. Includes all sites, buildings, structures & features normally associated with parks & urban spaces including street furniture."}
{"id": "ad0e95bd-9226-4d9d-b788-ea40c5550f3d", "value": "Timber or metal structure consisting of upright and cross members designed to support climbing plants."}
{"id": "c8a15467-8e47-4da6-a90e-306e089ebd8f", "value": "An area attached to a house, or part of an estate used for pleasure and recreation."}
{"id": "7a885c9d-4c52-46ee-a88e-323cf666f7fc", "value": "A body of water, building or structure found in a park or garden used as a water supply or ornament. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "0a77a5d6-c4cd-43b8-98b4-78fa8521973b", "value": "A garden or park, with ancilliary buildings, in which wild animals are kept and reared for public exhibition."}
{"id": "973763b6-8609-427d-8055-c30809bb7cc7", "value": "Trees planted in an ornamental circle. For earthwork surrounding trees use TREE ENCLOSURE RING."}

{"id": "a77845fd-6593-4cee-977f-8357896bc072", "value": "An area of land, usually planted with creeping plants and turf, laid out in a woodland landscape to produce the natural effect of a clearing."}
{"id": "7c8e47da-8192-4b63-8ee1-3c1ef58db1bb", "value": "A row of balusters, usually made of stone, surmounted by a rail or coping."}
{"id": "60b43b54-6b87-47cf-98c3-23938f9268fd", "value": "A functioning clock designed to serve also as an ornamental feature or sculpture."}

{"id": "7198c36f-b48a-4106-b173-85b60e2418c5", "value": "A small structure comprising of a 'shelf' of wood or metal sitting on pillars and erected for the benefit of porters to allow them to rest their burdens."}
{"id": "0d9a6011-fe3e-40f8-b389-05c742700670", "value": "An alignment of trees planted as part of a designed landscape. For a belt lining a road use TREE AVENUE."}
{"id": "b45a06b9-a2a4-484e-99d1-7d64b86eb70b", "value": "An outdoor theatre for the staging of dramatic productions."}

{"id": "71f1015e-bf59-4ddb-a662-b109e5ef5686", "value": "Originally a fence against which trees and shrubs were grown. Later used to describe a row of trees and shrubs forming a hedge clipped into a green wall."}
{"id": "61e0f782-ce15-4527-bdd5-5f3f6c6c0200", "value": "A garden building usually in a secluded spot, resembling a hermit's dwelling and built as a resting place, retreat or viewing point."}
{"id": "47fb45a5-92cb-40fb-8a1d-b5262fd82562", "value": "An area of common grassland in a village used for grazing cattle, recreational purposes, etc."}
{"id": "28238bee-f0be-4f8a-9adb-cc186bd027ae", "value": "A geometrical planting of trees in the form of the number 5 as represented on a dice."}
{"id": "070e8843-15a9-4981-920a-510693882d4e", "value": "An artificial hill constructed in Tudor gardens, especially, to provide a good view."}
{"id": "7944d922-b6d7-4b75-bc32-99a93d7db983", "value": "A small body of water, either natural or artificial."}

{"id": "f680027c-1ea3-48f0-af6e-684a999f8653", "value": "Areas of land that have been designated as national property where habitation and commercial activities are restricted to preserve their outstanding landscapes."}

{"id": "7fe9d816-3f9e-41b2-a985-b046bb9f110d", "value": "A shady cavern built as a garden feature. In the 18th century it usually took the form of an artificial rocky cave or apartment decorated with stalactites and shells in a wild part of the grounds."}
{"id": "a2eb2564-7a7e-41df-b75b-ba0a2517db7a", "value": "A strip of cultivated land situated against the exterior of a walled garden's perimeter, so placed to maximise usable wall space."}
{"id": "7a9c4237-dc17-45b3-b017-ab1f7ec6e3ea", "value": "A plantation of shrubs."}
{"id": "5ae20bb1-4f41-40f4-9bbb-64951df31890", "value": "A building or works in which carriages were built. Use RAILWAY CARRIAGE WORKS for sites making railway carriages."}
{"id": "a6702f48-7529-4426-95d9-d350758378be", "value": "A house in which a pair of curved timbers form a bowed A-frame which supports the roof independently of the walls."}
{"id": "be040f11-d855-431f-9849-ddd3e831ba5f", "value": "A CRUCK HOUSE where the cruck blades are truncated and joined by a collar beam, above which is a separate roof construction."}
{"id": "da821a85-f3bb-4b37-9e55-6f7760f16141", "value": "A workshop in which products are made using wood and timber."}
{"id": "4589be5f-cf56-42a4-8901-1daaef716c66", "value": "A building or workshop where fine furniture, often veneered, is made."}
{"id": "e18517b8-4d5d-4c51-9386-9c5449623087", "value": "A small, usually inexpensive, restaurant with a limited menu of light meals served at counters or tables."}
{"id": "f499c947-8e8b-413a-afed-89576efc6266", "value": "A factory or complex containing machinery for the manufacture of printed materials."}
{"id": "56d39574-af99-4e39-8097-9f3829e49b4d", "value": "A building or set of rooms where a newspaper is compiled and produced, before being printed. May include facilities for printing."}
{"id": "46924dfd-a185-469b-8a56-b57fd66f8418", "value": "A factory complex consisting of PRINTING SHOPS, COLOUR HOUSES, DYE HOUSES, etc, in which patterns are printed onto calico."}
{"id": "06031943-c873-499b-9818-f0cf18a6c787", "value": "A place where goods are sold in bulk, rather than by retail."}
{"id": "a0bd245a-83bb-4e6e-b733-dcc7e876d8f0", "value": "A site where aircraft are stored, dismantled and processed for the recovery of serviceable parts."}
{"id": "fe4402cf-0b33-4110-99ab-61790e996e14", "value": "A building or school where music is taught."}

{"id": "2570dc77-ed31-4782-84b5-07d0a27bede5", "value": "A calciner dating from the early 17th to early 20th centuries, usually made of brick and without moving parts, consisting of a reverberatory furnace, and used for the extraction of arsenic."}

{"id": "2ac41fff-0f8d-47b1-ae95-0dfc85bf5f68", "value": "A site where household rubbish and other waste products can be disposed of. May take the form of a pit, rubbish tip, landfill site or incineration plant."}
{"id": "66d808d2-699c-448f-bfd4-22f48a86ac7e", "value": "Non-pavilion type of attached ward block."}
{"id": "5db0ec2f-da61-4911-8f7d-da447f25ca9b", "value": "A shelter, sometimes camouflaged, for the observation of birds and animals at close quarters."}
{"id": "f6b90464-c4c6-486c-9091-843c392af813", "value": "A building where carpets and other floor furnishings were woven."}
{"id": "380f1636-783b-4d8d-a247-16d25937009c", "value": "A handloom weavers workshop where the weaver received yarn from a clothier and manufactured a woven piece of cloth from it."}
{"id": "bec92947-5bdd-4fc4-91f0-2b776514dc77", "value": "A workshop where tapestries were made."}

{"id": "c729a976-366d-4699-a065-5f57e608b9b2", "value": "A subterranean feature entered from a hillside, cliff face, etc. A cave may have been used for occupation, storage, burial, refuse, or as a hide-away. Index with site type or objects where known."}
{"id": "26320c25-31c4-4bd7-81dc-70d61967f109", "value": "Use only for natural features mistakenly assumed to be archaeological or natural features with archaeological significance."}

{"id": "aa3404c7-86b8-4f41-a59e-dcba6c11e175", "value": "Former terrestrial landscape of any kind now submerged through erosion, as at Dunwich, or historical inundation processes, eg. post-glacial submersion of the North Sea landscape (\"Doggerland\")."}
{"id": "7832ffea-fe8f-4b25-a667-c8e9680bff08", "value": "The course or channel of a river or stream preserved as a geological feature."}

{"id": "530aedf4-330e-44f4-84ba-55cde400fcb6", "value": "Soil marks and other features of natural origin, including periglacial frost wedging, solifluction deposits, abandoned water courses, etc, recorded to avoid future confusion with features of human origin."}

{"id": "ffcbaa24-ee9f-4daf-a6dd-355c52d0a157", "value": "The area beneath a natural overhang at the base of a cliff or crag. This may have been used for occupation, burial, etc. Index with site type where known."}
{"id": "9aa94e73-4aec-4d3c-86cb-a682b1831878", "value": "A heated stone, brick or iron chamber used for drying corn."}

{"id": "fe47f5f4-6237-4387-8574-fe11e0c194d3", "value": "A building, usually part of a textile mill complex, where warp yarn is sized prior to weaving. Sizing is the application of a starch solution to warp threads to add strength and protection."}
{"id": "7220402b-d899-488f-aed4-73ecdf6b1f83", "value": "A nonconformist church for the followers of Edward Irving."}
{"id": "31638787-23d8-46c3-a707-43f44cd5fbd9", "value": "A lock at the point where two waterways join together."}
{"id": "0f01a762-a7c2-4d5e-8b2d-d43fe68eef15", "value": "A device for catching fish, may be a portable or permanent structure, often a fence or row stakes made in a river, harbour, etc"}
{"id": "b31107f9-6b88-4f64-a35e-3f8358e75947", "value": "A fence or row of stakes, often with nets attached forming an enclosure within a river or harbour and used for catching, or holding, fish."}
{"id": "69b9e1f8-2e91-43e9-b22e-fc1e659e1a3a", "value": "A section of a psychiatric hospital or psychiatric ward set aside for children and/or adolescents with mental illness."}
{"id": "ede13b0d-d988-4b1e-95e7-3824101f468f", "value": "A mill in which textile rags were ground, either to enable the fibres to be respun or to use the pulp in the manufacture of paper."}
{"id": "05954073-249b-42f6-b007-69f0d5c23df6", "value": "A light, mostly wooden errected structure serving as workshop for the building, storage, repair and maintenance of boats."}
{"id": "c2b3627f-df9c-4197-bf0e-5f567b27f936", "value": "A building where violins are manufactured and the art of violin making is taught."}
{"id": "e820de2d-c310-4abc-9bd4-60c7cd5e5c66", "value": "A building used for the preparation of animal skins and hides prior to the tanning process."}
{"id": "9e6dd714-2ff1-4131-bc18-cb9cb0d011de", "value": "A platform on which corpses are placed and allowed to decompose in the open air, so as to leave only the bones for subsequent burial."}
{"id": "78bfa572-0ac3-4868-b626-70b26a657dc5", "value": "The unarticulated remains of the body of a human being. If articulated use inhumation."}
{"id": "55e2349d-783f-43d4-90bc-7f2aace465cb", "value": "A Neolithic burial monument comprising a stone-built chamber within a mound of earth or stone. Use more specific type where known."}

{"id": "f95d22ac-6534-4a36-8d42-a844a0df801a", "value": "Triangular concrete pyramids with 6 feet long sides and 5 feet high, intended to impede enemy movement in the event of invasion. Thought to be confined geogaphically to Southern Command."}
{"id": "21b9ebbe-6589-460d-881f-87313778982c", "value": "A purpose built apparatus for the testing of helicopters."}

{"id": "7ab85465-ba07-42e4-9d4e-0e80a31258ad", "value": "A mechanical structure, consisting of a roller or beam on supports, round which a rope or chain is wound, and used for various purposes, eg. raising a bucket from a well, etc."}

{"id": "e09cbe3e-a0dd-490f-929c-17d520f68a9a", "value": "An anti-personnel device consisting of a 40 gallon fuel drum placed on top of an explosive charge and detonator. When detonated the barrel would explode sending burning fuel over the intended target."}
{"id": "3c6dcaee-8256-43de-96eb-72fed81a62ba", "value": "A vertical or inclined excavation giving access to an underground mine."}
{"id": "3d024f48-7daa-4268-8a7c-86a8ca2ca480", "value": "Circular spoil heap surrounding a wide central depression, the entrance to a mine shaft."}
{"id": "18c027c6-0ef4-43e1-b10e-af2275aa2d47", "value": "A large space in an underground tunnel, usually wider than the tunnel itself, used for storage, etc."}
{"id": "8938c80d-03a3-4adf-af7b-d64511a685e2", "value": "A shaft allowing access to an area. Often used as an additional escape route to the main shaft in a mine or as an air shaft."}

{"id": "efead753-1ef9-4518-acb1-b85fd4542a9f", "value": "Plant for the processing of uranium ores, such as pitchblende. Uranium is the principal extract, but radium may also be recovered as a by-product"}
{"id": "7e1bc3ae-5875-4767-b6bc-f8d36c7b2bc8", "value": "Purpose built area, incorporating water supply, for the cleaning of carriages, carts, etc."}
{"id": "22f6a1c5-0a4c-48f8-8555-fb5cd4cb9757", "value": "A public house where no alcohol is sold."}
{"id": "84a8d96d-c479-4d2a-b0f0-629055cdf3b2", "value": "A hotel where no alcohol is available."}
{"id": "515cdc23-e9c0-481a-af85-682cd95edcea", "value": "A mill used for the processing of tin ore by crazing, stamping or smelting."}
{"id": "d9e896ac-2040-4b0f-b03a-23a8559594d8", "value": "A burial site for an animal, usually commemorated by a gravestone or other structure."}
{"id": "08c7f276-99ec-42b3-b7c9-6340ffc6dea2", "value": "A storehouse using mechanical means of controlling temperature rather than ice or insulation."}
{"id": "64003b9a-4cf0-4425-8996-f14ed54a7916", "value": "A room or small building kept at low temperatures for the storage of perishable items, particularly food."}
{"id": "3a70fbd6-18de-43fc-be01-eaae05c4ea47", "value": "A friary belonging to the Franciscan order. Includes houses of both Friars Minor and Friars Observant or Capuchins."}
{"id": "1236fd77-e359-4c7e-82d8-f269f2b93fcc", "value": "An abbey of Franciscan nuns also known as Minoresses or Poor Clares."}
{"id": "7662b87d-a068-4ec2-a74a-5b9eb0aeffec", "value": "A raised platform or stage for public speaking or conducting an orchestra. Also a platform for supporting cameras during filming."}
{"id": "fa4a8051-6e7c-4c2f-95f2-38bf29507001", "value": "A place where two artificial waterways meet each other."}

{"id": "2e6674fe-6d3c-4c5a-ab19-b43da62a3360", "value": "Residential area built to house athletes and their coaches at the Olympic Games. The buildings are generally reused as public housing after the contest."}
{"id": "fd917800-af0a-4093-b893-f1670bacda8b", "value": "A large room within a hospital set aside for emergency patients."}

{"id": "1986663a-23e0-4eac-a566-b9eff98e64bd", "value": "A camp used for the accommodation of members of the Womens Auxiliary Air Force who undertook a variety of essential roles within the RAF to enable their male counterparts to fight more effectively."}
{"id": "7d08cc91-e89e-4e24-93e8-fbb459e5b1f2", "value": "A school for pre-Infant school children, usually 3-5 years old."}
{"id": "04c70563-c110-4dca-bb8d-b8a1588736e7", "value": "A nursery for infants, where they are taken care of while their mothers are at work."}

{"id": "6d295b3c-009e-4e63-a24a-0e547a00eb51", "value": "A single-storey structure, usually situated against the exterior of a walled garden's south facing wall, used for storage and often accomodation."}

{"id": "844fda60-8eb5-4d3c-8e22-cdd49e6859ac", "value": "A cemetery of later prehistoric date comprising exclusively cremated human remains, some or all of which may be contained within pottery vessels. The cemetery area is partly or wholly surrounded by an earthwork bank and/or ditch."}
{"id": "5d826713-58dd-417e-86a9-ff32dfe191bf", "value": "A group of buildings in which local sewage is filtered and purified in large rectangular or circular tanks."}
{"id": "41934b4b-252c-4d64-bfb9-cacb42054f0e", "value": "A building housing filters for sewage. Usually associated with a sewage pumping station."}
{"id": "88e3c82f-35d4-4674-b25b-81717bb86b9b", "value": "An emplacement mounting a small, portable electrically-powered searchlight."}

{"id": "e7f49c3a-05b0-44c4-be09-72482e6c51ae", "value": "A site in which one or more searchlights and their accompanying structures were positioned to locate enemy aircraft or surface vessels for the benefit of batteries and night fighter aircraft."}
{"id": "234a151a-84b5-43f5-9a1a-0860216ea451", "value": "An area of land enclosed by two parallel ditches. Use with specific shaped enclosure where known."}

{"id": "b3090a9b-01d1-4923-8e83-a7d109a08aa5", "value": "A type of transportable aircraft hangar patented by Miskins and Sons in 1939. The arched hangar was constructed of steel or wooden ribs and generally clad in steel sheets. The hangar did not require any foundations and could be anchored by iron stakes."}
{"id": "a3a6ece6-77fd-49da-ac73-d3bb9c4b680d", "value": "A table found in a garden, often made of stone."}
{"id": "08efd8bb-fa6a-49cf-8f21-65e47506f18e", "value": "A site where an army or body of troops is, temporarily or permanently, lodged, with or without entrenchments and fortifications."}
{"id": "9a0e17be-cb6a-4366-9581-d7e946669dc7", "value": "A temporary kitchen set up in the field providing food for troops. Use with MILITARY CAMP if existence of this is known."}

{"id": "ba4926ad-925a-4b33-b24e-2e7ac9b9144c", "value": "An operations room, built to drawing number 367/41, to control the lighting arrays of the DREM type of bombing decoy in use during the Second World War. Unlike earlier designs it was surface built and then covered in earth to protect against flooding."}

{"id": "379183a3-0620-4468-972d-63acd42755cd", "value": "An operations room, built to drawing number 3395/40, to control the lighting arrays of the 'T' type of bombing decoy in use during the Second World War. It was semi-sunken for added protection and then covered in earth"}

{"id": "629ed07e-3b33-4244-bdc3-09d5e65457af", "value": "A decoy site designed to simulate the flarepath lighting of permanent RAF stations, to lure attacking night bombers away from legitimate targets."}

{"id": "e9ec8df3-8943-466a-9623-a7955eb78ce6", "value": "A wooden frame with holes, through which the head and hands of an offender were thrust, in which state they would be exposed to public ridicule and assault."}
{"id": "fec0a33f-b9b5-42fd-b6e3-1e3ca9b7d848", "value": "A site where acts of corporal and capital punishment were carried out."}
{"id": "e0e3d14d-73bc-48ac-aa20-8ec03c118c29", "value": "A place where people were put to death. Use narrower monument type where known."}

{"id": "0aee5801-f91d-4e47-9b16-cdeb03d05719", "value": "An instrument of punishment, in which the offender was placed in a sitting position in a timber frame, with holes to confine the ankles and wrists between two planks."}
{"id": "3e332872-b6d0-4663-8ad1-82038ca52a26", "value": "A post set up, to which offenders were tied to be whipped."}

{"id": "27e4156f-9e91-4721-aaeb-45a1e89b2309", "value": "A monument consisting of an area enclosed by a ditch, bank, wall, palisade or similar barrier, where the barrier follows a circular course, but is not regularly laid out."}
{"id": "eb7775ad-74df-413b-9f79-f12087f1c1e0", "value": "A site where a periodical gathering of buyers, sellers and entertainers, meet at a time ordained by charter or statute or by ancient custom."}
{"id": "44c66d2a-68ef-46d1-9bd1-78e1029e7d1e", "value": "Fairground attraction designed to create optical illusions to give a sense of unbalance and unease."}

{"id": "a7401789-39cf-4f71-a207-d972f7f35888", "value": "A stone-faced enclosure, with entrance closed by a floatable caisson or by gates, which can be pumped dry for inspection, maintenance, or repair of the hull or underwater fittings of a ship or ships."}
{"id": "02a7dddc-2e68-47b0-b5bc-4faa64735c4c", "value": "A sundial capable of giving an accurate reading of standard time to the minute."}

{"id": "58d1484e-a986-400e-987c-1e3eecd42045", "value": "A structure used to show the time of day by means of the sun shining on a 'gnomon', the shadow of which falls on the surface of the dial which is marked with a diagram showing the hours. Can be freestanding, usually on a pillar, or fixed to a building."}

{"id": "38a9d189-08b5-411c-ba47-e485a0f85a47", "value": "A glass sphere in a metal frame standing on a small pillar. A card is placed behind the sphere which focuses any sunlight, marking the card and thus indicating how many hours of sunlight there was on that day."}
{"id": "2aed9952-3dac-4a0a-9da2-d8b6c83f6c8a", "value": "A set of marks found on the wall of a building, thought to be a form of sundial."}
{"id": "bca7d22b-56b2-4248-8f57-b275b21bdd8f", "value": "A tower at the mouth of the harbour to defend the end of the harbour boom."}
{"id": "e998ca1b-4856-43d8-b647-8d45ac11c104", "value": "A site where coal is processed."}
{"id": "86cb115d-2137-4505-9e24-dda5419d28bb", "value": "Loading machinery tipping coal into railway wagons usually at a pithead."}
{"id": "d23d6296-cce3-4645-a5b8-dcd76baaf8fd", "value": "A building in which coal slurry, produced in the coal washing process, is recovered."}
{"id": "d2e676de-8320-4c8c-899c-e24b2773099b", "value": "A plant where freshly mined coal was washed down and any dust removed before loading for transport away from the colliery."}
{"id": "28372ca1-5fe9-460d-a2d0-c5620bb15235", "value": "A structure used for the storage of coal."}
{"id": "c763c502-896e-4a89-8ccb-d97e5cf40a0f", "value": "Buildings and structures associated with the mining industry."}
{"id": "0d1d6380-3670-4db0-8769-97a81492210d", "value": "A group of buildings and machines, usually situated close to the pithead, enabling the rapid, mechanized loading of goods wagons with coal."}
{"id": "180e1b8f-f1fa-4480-ab6c-70c307914b39", "value": "Includes terms for components of site. See also terms in MINING INDUSTRY SITE grouping."}
{"id": "ac37c0a1-1cce-4c34-bf16-4e149dd6e4c9", "value": "A building or range of buildings used for the cleaning, crushing and loading of freshly mined coal."}
{"id": "925194b4-5121-47fd-9f9b-c3bcd908f181", "value": "Series of wire mesh screens used for grading lumps of coal according to size."}

{"id": "d06453ce-7075-495e-98ed-1fc1489b38b3", "value": "A stable, on two or more levels."}

{"id": "ede83de6-05ef-4a0f-bb51-f9a87e5e9227", "value": "A timber framed house comprising horizontal and vertical timbers, forming the walls of the building and directly supporting the roof."}
{"id": "2a81d637-0daa-4fa2-bc80-a9eccc714704", "value": "A hilltop enclosure bounded by a double line of ramparts."}
{"id": "b8dddeed-4a67-411c-9f26-9ef478160a39", "value": "The limit line of a medieval local administrative unit of a hundred."}
{"id": "bb81b2d4-ed9a-4d63-af31-563e65f15939", "value": "A form of blast furnace. Steel is smelted in an open hearth while the waste gases are used to preheat the air blast."}

{"id": "045ee103-1505-404f-bf27-48fabec8be6f", "value": "A furnace composed of two fire brick boxes: the fire was in the lower box and the upper box held the crucibles. Used in the manufacture of steel."}

{"id": "2000dc60-c4bf-4df1-97a4-f13e6ea98d07", "value": "A site with accommodation buildings and ancillary facilities for Royal Air Force personnel."}

{"id": "639e290c-8c24-4218-897e-aee02a114f7e", "value": "An enclosed encampment, often featuring temporary or semi-permanent structures, used for the detention of prisoners of war, refugees or other civilians detained on political or social grounds."}

{"id": "8c965abd-0226-439b-98bd-54040c082fe4", "value": "A structure, often found in 18th century landscape gardens, that demonstrates eccentricity or excess rather than practical purpose. They can take many forms - ruins, sham castles, towers, hermits' cells or grottoes."}
{"id": "dc6f980e-51a3-46fb-a22c-e889c1462e97", "value": "A piece of ground used for motor racing."}
{"id": "9e7da83e-f9c4-4678-8411-7f5dcae16f57", "value": "Usually a rural hospital with up to 25 beds. Can include small pre-Cranleigh institutions, eg: dispensaries with in-patients."}

{"id": "889b0a9d-70e9-4178-b10a-7e55a2e57913", "value": "A place where wigs, hair-pieces and hair extensions are made and sold."}

These torpedoes were invented by Louis Philip Brennan. The stations were used to defend the coast from enemy shipping."}
{"id": "aa2cb4d3-c8d1-4aea-bd5d-81d1a5cf7538", "value": "Scaffolding intended to impede the advance of enemy armoured divisions. Often found in association with \"one way\" anti tank ditches."}

{"id": "2d419969-22bd-4d3f-805f-a93cdf71de41", "value": "Engineering workshop housing specialized machinery such as lathes, presses, etc., for making machines."}

{"id": "9565ea5a-dbdf-460a-9fb3-96ffd5138f96", "value": "An anti aircraft battery armed with 3 inch rockets with a ceiling of 22,000 feet. Both single and multiple launchers were designed. Single launchers being used to defend vulnerable points such as coastal batteries with multiple launchers defending town."}
{"id": "13ebb5aa-afdd-44ad-940b-369b8dca5e14", "value": "A place where processed cloth is cut for use as garments or soft furnishings, etc."}

{"id": "30c4690a-5d65-4af4-9f8f-1a57d9d35923", "value": "A type of tower mill, either with turbine-type sails able to take wind from any direction, or with sails working with shrouds to direct wind from one direction. The sails directly drove millstones set beneath them."}
{"id": "fc3c570e-75a4-43aa-902c-d6f4027d96b1", "value": "A box or place of confinement for animals, made wholly or partly of wire, wood or bars of metal, so as to admit air and light."}

{"id": "b7220f07-9c93-4ff8-a65e-d81190d197e6", "value": "A court, usually with only 2 walls, used for playing pelota and its variants."}
