{"id": "6d457e56-75bf-469e-baa6-9f01328f797c", "value": "A chute for conveying salt."}

{"id": "4184c533-6750-45aa-8397-3aef05a3e907", "value": "A row of houses linked at first floor level by an open continuous gallery which runs through the front of the buildings. Access to the gallery was gained by flights of steps. Commonly found in the city of Chester."}
{"id": "ebb4a7a6-e16d-4b89-a339-98d6131b892b", "value": "A site, often in a woodland clearing, used for the production of pure carbon by the controlled burning of wood and other organic materials."}
{"id": "24364e8c-9620-4680-9f51-3bea732b400f", "value": "A building or site conducting research into communication techniques for use in the Royal Navy."}
{"id": "bd0083e6-a0ea-42fa-aad8-688a9922b480", "value": "School built by the local Education Authority to provide residental schooling at the seaside for children from urban communities."}
{"id": "87c80884-b3d0-4199-9c5e-f9526410e699", "value": "A factory where explosives and the components of munitions of all types are brought together for assembly."}

{"id": "005bf3ad-5547-4c98-8c78-c9dc222e2e63", "value": "A settlement, usually enclosed, on a sloping hillside containing a number of oval or circular scopped house floors separated by walls or unexcavated ridges."}
{"id": "7449d950-8980-4fe5-a519-897ddc887fd8", "value": "A building from which the firing of torpedoes can be controlled and evaluated."}
{"id": "b3f5c357-a9f8-459f-b910-959be437bd20", "value": "An institution for the detention of prisoners considered to be a major threat to public safety and/or to the security of the nation."}

{"id": "776ac968-230f-4b13-834a-53e177b2fad9", "value": "A town founded as an act of government by charter to house Roman or Latin citizens, usually retired legionaires who had been granted land within a territorium."}
{"id": "0bfd7be8-80ba-41c9-922b-d078f571558b", "value": "An abbey or priory of the Trinitarian brethren also named Maturins."}
{"id": "86c7a1e7-0eb2-4114-8e96-caad2c170ef7", "value": "A factory used to make packaging."}
{"id": "73a57ad5-f4be-4132-9d0f-5ebb1650b927", "value": "A concrete marker placed to indicate the direction of a target on a bombing range to aircraft."}
{"id": "119ce97f-ab8d-4eab-a3f7-5194fdf6622f", "value": "A place where oysters are bred for consumption."}
{"id": "58d3247d-8f51-435d-a5ef-a32a711eda64", "value": "Part of textile mills."}
{"id": "5897e1c0-8dc1-425c-9659-abe75cdb549e", "value": "A small house built out of rough logs."}

{"id": "87636e95-2682-456d-a09e-b6c8252ae29f", "value": "A stone circle featuring four upright stones standing at the corners of an irregular quadrilateral. The monument may feature more than 4 stones, overall, but the corner stones are often the most prominent."}
{"id": "6ce3dfca-7af0-4906-a0fc-6a67d29d77a8", "value": "A privately-funded home for the care of the elderly."}

{"id": "8ca7f62b-a456-4658-993d-1b363c15db5f", "value": "Flats or houses first built by 19th century philanthropic societies as a model to encourage the development of approved working class housing."}
{"id": "4281abab-254d-45df-90a5-726d0d25e00e", "value": "A works engaged principally in the manufacture of the explosive bellite."}

{"id": "74bce41e-2021-4d4d-b990-c5c1943a9750", "value": "40mm gun emplacement created between 24th-26th June 1944 as part of the fourth deployment of Diver LAA guns to the Kentish Gun Belt. Each site had an extant searchlight battery."}
{"id": "cb3d3448-caea-42b8-b3ce-562cdb37a2e8", "value": "A factory, works or structure used for the manufacture and purification of gas."}
{"id": "8749a978-e1e5-420f-8c9a-e169d38a8d09", "value": "The residence of a master shipwright."}

{"id": "32c4993f-fe6f-486e-8855-42f57902d584", "value": "A non-profit making restaurant administered by a Local Food Committee which provided customers with good quality and wholesome food which could be purchased without ration coupons."}

{"id": "3472abe0-8f09-420b-8b63-2d5a78861e61", "value": "A large, circular, reinforced-concrete tank supported on concrete staging built to Air Ministry drawing number 1178/25 and designed to hold 30,000 gallons of water. The height of the tower varied according to local site requirements."}
{"id": "db9a7d77-7063-4147-8637-21ce820c5eba", "value": "Horizontal masonry or timber work at the entrance to a dock."}
{"id": "4499c66a-09f3-48b8-a44e-6c1907822c3b", "value": "A dwelling, located at the entrance, or gates, to an estate or park, etc."}

{"id": "bb00cab6-e710-4359-a588-f55fc27182bd", "value": "A place of worship for General Baptists, a movement established by John Smyth in 1603 and which grew out of the original Baptist church. They believed in free will and are often referred to simply as Baptists."}
{"id": "e508e94d-04f8-4199-addd-1f6f9cb9b25c", "value": "A plaque attached onto, or a line incised into, a wall face or other surface to indicate the height of flood water inundation."}

{"id": "b49020c2-50d3-4ae3-a8d7-ba7366f4efc1", "value": "A structure, based on drawing number (3329/41), intended to be the headquarters for the coordination of an airfield's defences. Constructed above ground this design was found to be vulnerable and was superceded by the (11008/41)."}

{"id": "d6593b33-3f7d-43d4-8db1-a2014dd726d8", "value": "A flat bottomed ditch flanked by mounds running to the south of Hadrian's Wall for much of its length, marking the boundary of the military zone."}
{"id": "f8621e00-1004-4446-9380-0dda7e06959f", "value": "For the production of clay tobacco pipes."}
{"id": "9c513a95-9b3d-4ba7-8c0b-0a0ded71752d", "value": "A factory where tobacco pipes made of clay are manufactured."}
{"id": "ce24ed17-5d72-4377-9f65-dd00a45b85f8", "value": "An elevated platform on which a criminal is executed."}

{"id": "8d40b74f-17da-4167-b8cd-0869c914c2df", "value": "A circle of spaced upright boulders emerging from a low, hemispherical, stony mound. The boulders may lean outwards due to pressure from the cairn material."}
{"id": "33c01130-e22c-4089-90b5-989205ab6f8f", "value": "An area of flattened or compacted ground used for charcoal burning."}
{"id": "65d24aae-ef14-4761-ad11-991165e08a16", "value": "A shed for storing fishing bait."}
{"id": "560d4cd5-bff2-495d-9040-92c310f28bcb", "value": "An area of agriculturally used land, which is divided into small, elongated, rectangular fields running parallel to each other."}
{"id": "7889cdd3-914d-4915-bf0e-7a809ace6445", "value": "An ore works at which gold was separated from the ore by the addition of mercury."}
{"id": "893f5e29-3373-4e29-8890-4eb3cbedefdf", "value": "A rural school serving a number of villages, built in Cambridgeshire in the 1930s."}
{"id": "7a9a8f8b-634d-440f-96b5-2c721ac57325", "value": "A building or site used for naval communications."}
{"id": "a3757b6e-fefd-47c6-ba2c-359f0a3ade98", "value": "Purposely built camp with recreational facilities and individual chalets for accommodation."}
{"id": "5d2b2eb8-a88c-461c-b2f2-38d7f57ad4fe", "value": "A farm building erected in the 18th and 19th century which were architect-designed rather than built in the local vernacular style."}

{"id": "6495ef9e-87e3-4033-a4f7-6cf515bf180d", "value": "Earthworks of uncertain date and purpose, consisting of cross-shaped banks sometimes with an accompanying ditch. Their distribution is largely confined to North Yorkshire."}
{"id": "07c8493d-a516-4771-82c2-7421c00fc0e5", "value": "An establishment where wine is produced."}
{"id": "d21c9c08-5546-45d1-88dd-74815a2aa248", "value": "A press in which the juice is extracted from grapes in the manufacture of wine."}
{"id": "1a399951-36e3-47d9-8505-5814fcd26de5", "value": "A factory used for the industrial manufacture of chlorophyll for medical purposes."}
{"id": "e060f6ec-32b6-4219-8bbc-a8afe2d6b8f4", "value": "An indoor market used for the sale of antique goods."}
{"id": "8603277b-4db5-427b-a8a0-bd76617533b4", "value": "A large building used to store tea."}
{"id": "cdb8ce52-f6f6-4368-91ae-1c7d7a3e4ad7", "value": "A large dish-like structure designed to observe the invisible outerspace phenomena detected by radio waves, eg. Jodrell Bank."}
{"id": "4e1ab662-1547-4d6d-9921-d51cc822b30a", "value": "A site, including buildings and hardstandings, used for the storage and distribution of ammunition."}

{"id": "74d3f8ef-bf70-42bc-a9b1-a46560a7fd8e", "value": "A planned administrative capital for local government which provided amenities for the Roman and peregrine (non-Roman) inhabitants of the town."}
{"id": "5b029def-fc74-41c2-9d73-c573ff623a68", "value": "A movable bridge lifted at one end by chains or ropes either to stop traffic passing over it or to let traffic pass under it."}
{"id": "d4fb8fd1-0689-4ff1-b6d3-d40b6f50c4de", "value": "A stall, often within a cow house, where cattle are kept individually."}
{"id": "600e51bf-38fa-428b-b905-33db2add1126", "value": "A small store building at a railway station for the storage of equipment and other stores associated with the railway."}
{"id": "e2362dff-9d2e-4ac4-8396-1a2d855d9b8b", "value": "Sites and structures associated with the cutting and processing of peat."}
{"id": "2e4734c9-d8b9-4ccd-9b5d-4b0c9d9ad021", "value": "A school design consisting of single-storey buildings with classrooms entered from a verandah."}
{"id": "d8653d63-e085-4163-9350-595c934b531a", "value": "A slab of stone, either standing or recumbent, inscribed with a cross. Usually found in association with burials."}
{"id": "99c88a5b-f900-4750-bcc9-237590eb5032", "value": "A small Anglo-Saxon cross-slab buried on the breast or beneath the head of a corpse."}
{"id": "43132f02-cc3b-4013-8448-cfc8dd2a05e0", "value": "A place where architectural ornaments such as stone vases and urns are manufactured."}
{"id": "288c49ab-dc12-4c02-b5f1-13d04347631c", "value": "A tower used as a watch tower by the coastguard. Often, though not always, built as part of a Coastguard Station."}
{"id": "f403a307-860c-4d47-a9a8-ef60eea73cb8", "value": "A house consisting of a single storey hall with two storey domestic ranges attached to either one or both ends."}
{"id": "cd8280d9-3418-49c9-9323-940505a553e5", "value": "A place at a school where children receive medical advice, health checks and treatment."}
{"id": "eb7fde72-84da-44f0-a6bf-b68c9191e3f2", "value": "Long parallel soil ridges in excess of 5 metres across separated by furrows, formed by using a heavy plough capable of turning the soil."}

skos:Concept.skos:altLabel: {"id": "f01ccb82-2f77-4fa0-a1bb-e430d7e868d8", "value": "Royal Flying Corps Side Opening Aircraft Hangar"}
skos:Concept.skos:scopeNote: {"id": "6c190334-4fd3-4ff0-b629-dea0981b5232", "value": "The earliest side-opening standard type of aircraft hangar designed in 1913 and used in WWI. Originally constructed from wooden trusses and struts, one example has steel frames. It comprised a single or coupled shed with rear workshops."}
{"id": "3751d0d1-2192-4e7b-bd79-50fbd04a6fa8", "value": "A factory for the production of missiles"}
{"id": "a23504f7-9488-4254-a149-2376843b2502", "value": "A row of columns supporting an entablature."}

{"id": "c7253f3c-0fdf-46ce-b4b2-6fc07125eebc", "value": "A radar station with sets operating on a wavelength of 1.5m. Chain Home Low Stations were intended for use in locating low-flying aircraft but was also capable of detecting high-flying aircraft."}
{"id": "68b4b63a-48d1-4215-b796-2e9239a8c5d3", "value": "A building, administered by the Navy, Army and Air Force Institutes, providing retail and leisure services to members of the armed forces."}

{"id": "cb2dd938-10f7-4180-9f32-9a6eb4c8e005", "value": "A large circular defence work surrounded by a brick revetted ditch and sunken below a glacis. Usually built out of brick with the embrasures lined with granite blocks. Armed with ten or elven guns. Early 19th century as part of coastline defence."}
{"id": "b359e4d1-a007-44e9-95a9-a6f4dc3f7a03", "value": "A standard latine block on RAF airfields."}

{"id": "cdbbc4d2-2d0a-4c96-af42-e11185fdf4b6", "value": "A type of temporary transportable aircraft hangar designed in 1936 by N.S. Bellman. It was designed for ease of installation, and was composed of light rolled steel sections."}
{"id": "fec7cb32-695a-480c-b860-b3ca33eeeaff", "value": "A mill used for the extraction and processing of starch."}
{"id": "035efffc-dccc-447a-a6c7-16ccf70e3d26", "value": "A plate-steel water tank on a steel tower designed to hold 80,000 gallons of water. Designed to Air Ministry drawing number 9526/41."}
{"id": "6441cd0d-b535-409b-a7a1-b8930d86bfa7", "value": "A factory manufacturing electrical equipment, such as engines, transformers and generators for use in industry."}
{"id": "fdfc2fa6-15fd-46ab-bf16-a2ed91a4f786", "value": "A fire station built for use by the Auxiliary Fire Service, established in 1938 to supplement existing local brigades."}
{"id": "7752c9cf-7301-4a30-8416-cab3911f92c7", "value": "A portable indoor air raid shelter in the form of a steel topped table, often with wire meshing around the sides."}
{"id": "7a694ebf-e748-4b38-8d40-b964eb97f55f", "value": "A group of related buildings, primarily with a domestic function, which is arranged along a principle axis such as a main road or routeway."}
{"id": "664c60a8-b53a-4732-9942-1b7b1fdc0492", "value": "The limit line of an area pertaining to a medieval manor."}
{"id": "c2ade36c-1314-4c0d-99ad-71d85201f908", "value": "Sacred Jewish texts and appurtenances buried within a Jewish cemetery."}
{"id": "dc9b780b-a632-4ca3-986c-1a19b0143617", "value": "An institution for convicted prisoners held under a regime which strove to reform by means of silent isolation and labour."}
{"id": "1bc12ea5-9162-4579-91d6-922c0edae4a5", "value": "A house with no row of posts between the central space and the aisles."}
{"id": "6f1f6ad3-8d30-4762-aad9-6b06be2a6108", "value": "A factory or works principally engaged in the refining or manufacture of TNT."}

{"id": "656313c2-635d-4891-b422-084aef09cf9f", "value": "An area of a port, dock or harbour, often including buildings for passport control and customs, where passengers and vehicles using hovercraft services can embark/disembark and where supplies can be taken on board."}

{"id": "5a2756e9-7b63-4b9f-9eea-bbe6120c1db9", "value": "An offshoot of the Wesleyan movement founded in 1838 by John Banyard at Rochford, Essex. In 1956 it changed name to the Union of Evangelical Churches. There are 17 chapels in Essex and London."}
{"id": "d6235bc1-7ac2-49d6-b51e-23a99aad0796", "value": "A piece of ground on which athletes race."}
{"id": "83f02eb2-0716-45ad-a816-7114dde93d06", "value": "A site where petroleum is drawn."}
{"id": "a1330158-7987-4525-b0b4-eee740574587", "value": "A market for the sale of cheeses."}
{"id": "7ff0f63b-9bc7-4812-b09a-c2e12e4b19dc", "value": "A large drainage channel used for improving the land."}

{"id": "b6d9a5f7-6cfe-4941-b38d-ff92d7b21617", "value": "A place of worship for members of the United Methodist Free Church. Formed in 1857 by the amalgamation of the Methodist Reform Church and the Wesleyan Association they later became part of the United Methodist Church in 1907."}

{"id": "2f7889d5-e051-4dee-8985-33e319b1daca", "value": "A military side-opening aircraft hangar originally designed for seaplanes and used RNAS bases from 1916. Steel framed with asbestos or corrugated iron cladding."}
{"id": "f2199a98-863c-4fc1-b621-26ad6bbcf52b", "value": "A large, luxuriously appointed hotel."}

{"id": "773d790e-9101-4af7-8d8f-0c27f0ebc07b", "value": "A lighthouse whose lantern is sufficiently low to be seen below low lying cloud. In locations where varying weather conditions occur a Low Light is usually accompanied by a HIGH LIGHT built alongside or nearby."}
{"id": "62058160-504f-4502-b887-42826e84bf1b", "value": "One or more coils of barbed wire intended to impede the advance of hostile troops."}

{"id": "f1b302ea-d488-4677-a775-293ac9f17cac", "value": "Sites, buildings or structures involved in passive air defence, usually by forcing hostile aircraft to fly high or drop their bombs on the wrong targets. Use more specific term."}
{"id": "196871cd-cc75-45ca-bb0d-9133223c55df", "value": "A column, in the form of a female figure, used to support an entablature."}
{"id": "49d24138-1655-49b7-b267-fdb0a392fbcd", "value": "A place where hats are made and sold."}
{"id": "d1532b36-db98-454a-abf3-69d12f53a7c9", "value": "A hoist suspended from a girder within the roof of a building or workshop."}
{"id": "2dca0bf5-507d-48d5-a274-bd5966eb40ca", "value": "A building where people could bathe in salt water. Salt water was believed to have medicinal properties."}
{"id": "84c290eb-e5f2-4b1c-9df7-bc009ea1d4ca", "value": "A decorative garden ornament, usually of stone, in the form of a wide, shallow dish."}
{"id": "f9f3ee43-aa6f-4dcc-9819-a936bf22b8e8", "value": "A factory where security safes are manufactured."}
{"id": "7a89f33e-fd11-45a0-bfa9-151882b9007d", "value": "A settlement used for trading."}
{"id": "831d81fb-4377-4733-b0f4-5f6c6649cf14", "value": "A building wherein silk worm cocoons are boiled to release the silk fibres."}
{"id": "ffc78273-4b06-42fb-92a4-6c490536590f", "value": "A building or site used for the storage of goods or equipment."}
{"id": "a72e600c-bfb8-40d8-851a-865d4d1919fd", "value": "A barn in which a pair of curved timbers form a bowed A-frame which supports the roof independently of the walls."}
{"id": "59f9e0d9-b4e5-4de2-a6bd-2be8bbc3944b", "value": "An area of prepared ground on which a sport is played. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "f0677cb4-0d10-497c-bb89-331c3f0cedaf", "value": "An area of ground used for the game of quoits."}
{"id": "7c66ecc7-a988-4c52-a1d5-22f97cfd5956", "value": "Fast arterial road with separate carriageways limited to motor vehicles"}
{"id": "17d70d92-f40b-42f7-976a-edad03b8c950", "value": "A brick tower, based on drawing number (9290/42), usually added to an existing building. Used for the drying of parachutes."}
{"id": "12a41960-82cb-46de-8304-c5711207eafa", "value": "A designated area of water in which the perfromance of torpedoes can be evaluated."}
{"id": "e0391bfd-d3cb-4921-ba2f-4f7b633c24bf", "value": "Ornamental garden building constructed within the branches of trees."}
{"id": "6d8ecd06-d425-48f5-addd-21936cdc844e", "value": "An establishment where people get their hair dressed and cut."}
{"id": "f4160acd-1b27-4a6e-8e8d-a6e88dd06d44", "value": "A hairdressing establishment for men."}

{"id": "3e49f581-ea7b-4096-80fe-94a5d2a75e66", "value": "A place of worship for Wesleyan Methodists. This was the original Methodist church from which the other denominations seceded. In 1932 they joined the United Methodists and the Primitive Methodists to form the Methodist church."}
{"id": "00c310fd-78d0-4e42-ab5f-7a19d63d4f1d", "value": "A stone commemorating the date of a specific event."}
{"id": "bffa1140-0d50-4028-8b46-f5602f7b9567", "value": "A site where canvas, coarse, unbleached cloth, made from hemp or flax, was manufactured."}
{"id": "df74a255-368e-4822-98e2-b99b118886ab", "value": "A depot or warehouse for the storage, distribution and repair of shoe making machines."}
{"id": "4c6bb0a2-e895-47e5-aaa0-bbb20a107297", "value": "A market consisting of stalls erected in the street and selling a variety of goods."}
{"id": "e82f8741-21e5-48a3-b2bd-3eba242d102e", "value": "A long bed planted with perennial flowers and plants."}

{"id": "5a7369a7-df7d-464f-92cb-fbf0283d8430", "value": "A supermarket for American military personnel, the National Guard and the Reserves and their immediate family, usually sited on a military installation throughout the world. Use term only in conjunction with an American military base."}
{"id": "42b98c3d-88a7-42ec-9038-aad5aeaabdb6", "value": "An area in a town where traffic is prohibited, often containing shops."}
{"id": "090cfba4-ca7c-44f7-b508-189877b6176b", "value": "The bottom of a dock."}

{"id": "7dfd4235-b6d4-4f1a-b59c-82c6f222c689", "value": "A matzevah from the Sephardi group of Jews descended from medieval Jewish communities of the Iberian Peninsular and Northern Africa. Characterised by flat slabs with Hebrew Inscriptions"}

{"id": "644985fc-8f56-48ad-9507-a7e65c6f9613", "value": "A building temporarily requistioned for use as a hospital. Auxiliary hospitals treated the less seriously wounded and were less strict than military hospitals although they remained under military control."}
{"id": "5c5f4707-a467-4cb6-9f0c-26045dbeec4b", "value": "Block for the treatment of separate diseases."}
{"id": "326c1df2-e0c0-46d3-b36b-c9f9dccb4a75", "value": "A hospital where people would pay a subscription in order to recieve treatment when ill."}
{"id": "854d78b3-d09e-4bc6-b66f-3c462d8743cc", "value": "A prepared area of grass on which the game of football is played."}
{"id": "ff9f5245-58ed-4e71-a578-331476241e16", "value": "A building in a garden or park designed to provide a shady retreat from the heat of the sun."}
{"id": "73e0be0a-d517-4f62-b035-464ed2649b72", "value": "A building or room where railway tickets may be bought and administrative duties associated with a railway are conducted."}
{"id": "402e2d0c-167e-4980-bcce-60f38fdef4d9", "value": "A prepared area, traditionally grass, where tennis is played."}
{"id": "edbbbb17-5d51-463f-89f1-195e6521252c", "value": "A small arched hangar built by the Canadian company Fromson of Byfleet to drawing number 3971/43. Used only as storage sheds on RNASs."}

{"id": "f285056f-f828-47e1-b334-e0a422fd37f2", "value": "An area of a port, dock or harbour, often including buildings for passport control and customs, where passengers of ocean liners can embark/disembark and where supplies can be taken on board."}

{"id": "9cbf008e-4890-406d-af75-824ee3d6791c", "value": "A site, complex or building which has been converted for use as the headquarters for the civilian authorities in the event of a nuclear attack or major natural disaster destroying the seat of government."}

{"id": "11d98326-156d-4476-bd98-d21a2e6ead62", "value": "Based on the previous all-timber design 2423/39 and the temporary brick and timber design 518/40, the 8936/40 was built with pre-cast concrete slabs replacing the timber floors and staircases with only the balcony and watch office roof in timber."}
{"id": "f1c9d028-11c3-4753-9b5e-5cd7d15a4734", "value": "A mound kerbed with wooden stakes or boulders."}
{"id": "47762786-170a-4c2e-82bf-94bcf15ad4b7", "value": "The hull of a dismantled ship used as a prison."}

{"id": "4bd95cdd-21ba-47c0-9563-9c2c87a94ace", "value": "The standard RFC power house built to Air Ministry drawing number 476/18 and comprising an engine room with a small workshop and driver's room."}
